new_roles.title: Director, Utilization Management Operations
new_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**This role is fully remote and must be located within the 50 U.S. states. Standard working hours are in Eastern Timezone. Semi-annual travel may be required to a Devoted office for on-site work.**

**A bit about this role:**

At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family. Devoted is growing at an incredible pace, and we are thrilled to welcome and serve every new member who joins us. This growth demands that our Utilization Management (UM) operation must scale and evolve without ever losing sight of the people at the center of every authorization.

We believe UM done right means decisions that are correct, fair, and fast, delivered through a frictionless process and with heart. Behind every request is a member waiting on care and a provider working to deliver it. UM is hard, but the challenge doesn’t exempt us from our mission.

We are seeking a curious, operationally minded leader to serve as Director, Utilization Management Operations. Reporting to the Vice President of Health Services, you will lead the teams behind our administrative work: a large onshore and offshore team of UM Administrative Coordinators who manage intake, outreach, notifications, and follow-up. You will also hold dotted-line accountability for monitoring and ensuring the success of our Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT).

This role is for someone who is energized by a complex process: someone who wants to unravel it, reimagine it, and lead the build of something simpler, faster, and more consistent. You will have significant influence over the roadmap for Orinoco, our internal technology platform, and an integrated AI engine to put to work. This role will help pave the way towards realizing the next generation of our UM program, driving improvements in effectiveness, efficiency, and experience for our members and provider partners.

**Your Responsibilities and Impact will include**:

* **SLA & Timeliness Ownership:** Own SLA performance for the administrative steps that support authorization review across UM, delivering consistent, predictable performance at a meaningfully lower cost. Hold dotted-line accountability for Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT), partnering with the clinical leaders of that team to monitor performance, surface risks early, and remove administrative barriers to on-time decisions.
* **Process Reimagination:** Map our administrative processes end to end, including auth intake, requests for additional clinical information, facility census checks, member and provider notifications, and member follow-up, and lead their redesign for speed, consistency, and simplicity.
* **Technology & AI Leadership:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the Orinoco roadmap so that process and technology evolve together. Put our integrated AI tools to work to remove manual effort, so our administrative capacity no longer has to grow at the same rate as our membership.
* **Build for Measurement:** Design processes that are highly measurable and transparent by default. Partner with Data Science to define and monitor the KPIs that matter, including timeliness, cost per authorization, quality, and provider experience, and use them to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
* **People & Vendor Leadership:** Lead and develop a team that includes approximately 50 onshore UM Administrative Coordinators and their leaders. Manage our offshore vendor partnership, which supports more than 250 administrative team members, holding it to clear performance standards while building a shared culture of ownership and care.
* **Provider & Member Experience:** Partner with the Provider Network team to understand what providers and facilities need from this process, and build it in. Design every touchpoint, from outreach to notifications to follow-up, with the humans on the other end in mind.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Work closely with the Senior Director of UM, who owns end-to-end authorization performance, along with the UM Medical Directors, Compliance, Provider Network, Data Science, and Engineering teams to keep the operation aligned and consistently audit-ready.

**Required skills and experience:**

* **Mission & Heart:** A genuine commitment to treating members like family, and a belief that operational excellence and empathy belong together.
* **Proven Operator at Scale:** A track record of leading high-volume operations that deliver consistent SLA performance.
* **Builder Mindset:** Experience taking a complex, multi-step process apart and leading the build of a simpler, more scalable one, rather than only maintaining what exists. You are naturally curious and ask why a step exists before deciding how to improve it.
* **Metrics-Oriented:** You build for measurement, are comfortable working deep in the workflows and the data, and use both to drive decisions and hold teams and partners accountable.
* **Technology & AI Curiosity:** Experience partnering with product and engineering teams, and genuine excitement about using AI-enabled tools to transform how work gets done.
* **Vendor Management:** Experience managing vendor partners against clear performance and quality standards.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex problems into actionable updates for leadership and stakeholders.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree required.

**Desired skills and experience**:

* **Healthcare Operations:** Experience in payer operations, utilization management, claims, provider revenue cycle, or a similar high-volume healthcare environment. Prior UM experience is not required.
* **Medicare Advantage Familiarity:** Understanding of Medicare Advantage operations and CMS requirements.
* **Advanced Degree:** MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.
* MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.

#LI-Remote 
#LI-DS1

***Salary range:*** $182,000 - 247,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

* Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium
* Generous paid time off
* $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend
* Stock options for all employees
* Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles
* Parental leave program
* 401K program
* And more....

* *Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.*

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

 

We have been made aware of instances of fraudulent job postings and/or fraudulent recruiting activity by individuals purporting to represent Devoted Health. These fraudulent schemes often seek monetary contributions or payments from job seekers (such as for “start up costs” or “equipment”), or seek to collect sensitive personal information. These job postings and offers are **NOT**authorized by Devoted Health and Devoted is not responsible for fraudulent offers, personal information that you may have disclosed, or payments made to third parties purporting to represent Devoted. We have reported this matter and are cooperating with law enforcement agencies. Devoted Health will never ask for financial commitment or contribution from a candidate at any stage of the recruitment process.

Job Profile Summary 
The Director, Operations - Prime Line is responsible for the overall operational performance of the Prime Line distribution network, providing strategic leadership and direction to deliver best-in-class service, safety, quality, productivity, and financial results. This role drives operational excellence across all locations, develops high-performing leadership teams, drives accountability and partners cross-functionally to execute business strategies that support growth, customer satisfaction, and long-term organizational success.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Leadership & Operational Excellence**

* Provides strategic leadership for all Prime Line locations, establishing operational priorities and driving execution against safety, service, productivity, quality and financial objectives.

* Owns operational and financial performance across all Prime Line locations, optimizing labor, distribution, inventory flow, service levels, and operating costs to achieve business objectives and profitability targets.
* Collaborates cross-functionally to align operations with enterprise goals.
* Oversees turnaround strategies for underperforming locations and drives a culture of continuous improvement.
* Develops and executes network strategies that support growth, operational scalability, and long-term business performance.

**Talent Development & Team Leadership**

* Hires, manages, and develops high-performing Operations teams across Prime Line locations.
* Builds a high-performing leadership culture through talent development, succession planning, performance management, and leadership capability enhancement.
* Coaches and mentors leaders to promote accountability; acts quickly when performance does not meet expectations.
* Conducts performance reviews and supports succession planning and career development**.**

**Customer Experience and Operational Partnership**

* Champions initiatives that enhance customer experience through operational excellence.
* Leverages Operations Excellence insights and feedback to drive innovation in service delivery.
* Aligns operational strategies with evolving customer and Prime Line Supply Chain expectations.

* Leads initiatives that improve customer service performance, delivery execution, and overall customer satisfaction.
* Partners closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Merchandising, and Customer Service teams to ensure operational strategies align with customer expectations and business priorities.

**Accountability & Engagement**

* Ensures compliance with all regulatory requirements, company policies, food safety standards, and workplace safety expectations.
* Leads business reviews, presents performance insights to executive leadership, and develops action plans to address risks and opportunities.
* Drives associate engagement through effective leadership, recognition, and communication, fostering a culture of accountability, transparency and operational integrity.
* Leads organizational change initiatives and operational transformations to support business growth and evolving customer needs.

 

* Other duties as assigned by manager.

* Directly supervises operations leadership at all Prime Line locations.

**RELATIONSHIPS:**

* **Internal**: Prime Line Leadership Team, Mergers and Acquisitions Integration Team, Field Operations, Supply Chain Planning & Replenishment, Region and Area Presidents; Area, Region and HR business partners; Program Office change resources and other Operations, Program Office, Commercial Center of Excellence and Supply Chain leaders.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**:

new_roles.description:
### **Your Impact as a Regional Operations Director**

As a Regional Operations Director, you are a key leader responsible for the success and health of a diverse portfolio of veterinary hospitals. You will serve as the crucial link between local hospital teams and the broader Mission Pet Health network, empowering your teams to achieve excellence in both business performance and patient care.

* **Champion a Thriving Culture:** You'll partner with your Regional Medical Director to foster a positive, engaged, and high-performing culture across all hospitals in your region.
* **Develop Future Leaders:** You'll guide the growth of Hospital Managers and their teams, ensuring a strong pipeline of talent through effective coaching, training, and career development.
* **Drive Business Performance:** You'll have full ownership of the financial health of your region, managing P&Ls to drive revenue growth and optimize operational efficiency.
* **Build Winning Teams:** You'll lead the strategy for non-DVM recruiting and staffing, ensuring your hospitals have the talent they need to succeed.
* **Elevate the Client Experience:** You'll set the standard for exceptional client service, ensuring operational processes support a seamless and positive experience for every pet owner.

### **What You'll Bring to the Team**

* A proven track record of successful multi-site P&L management, with a keen ability to drive financial results.
* Demonstrated success in recruiting, developing, and retaining high-performing teams, especially in a leadership capacity.
* Exceptional leadership skills with a talent for building a positive, accountable, and solutions-focused culture.
* Excellent communication and conflict management skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences.
* Significant experience leading in a multi-site veterinary, healthcare, or customer-centric retail environment.

### **How You're Supported**

*As part of the Mission Pet Health family, you get the stability of a local practice backed by the comprehensive benefits and resources of a larger network. The focus is on investing in you, so you can focus on what you love.* 
 
*Note: Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you at every stage. Eligibility for specific benefits varies based on your role and hours worked.*

##### **Competitive Compensation**

A competitive hourly rate or salary based on your experience and role.

##### **Health & Wellbeing**

We offer comprehensive coverage options including Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, along with access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for all teammates.

##### **Financial Security**

Plan for your future with our 401k retirement options and additional financial protection benefits like Life Insurance and Disability coverage.

##### **Commitment to Growth**

We support your career goals with opportunities for professional development, including educational assistance for qualified teammates to enroll in AVMA-accredited veterinary technician programs.

##### **The Power of a Network**

Join a nationwide community of over 20,000 veterinary professionals who share a passion for collaboration, career growth, and sharing best practices.

##### **Valuable Perks**

Enjoy discounted veterinary care for your own pets, access to an online discount platform, and free 24/7 access to doctors through Teladoc.

### **About Mission Pet Health**

Mission Pet Health was founded by veterinarians on the belief that local practices thrive with clinical autonomy, collaboration, and medical excellence. The organization provides world-class support to its 850+ hospital teams on a hyper-local basis so they can focus on what matters most: the medicine, their patients, and their team culture. Learn more at **missionpethealth.com**.

Driving the award-winning culture are the WAG values – **Work Together, Amaze, and Grow**. Mission Pet Health is veterinarian-led, people-focused, and on a mission to be the best place to work in veterinary medicine. We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 "Most Loved Workplace," ranked #2 in America's Top 100 and #1 in veterinary care.

**Reasonable Accommodations:** Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation. Please contact benefits@mvetpartners.com with your request and contact information.

**EEO Statement:** Mission Pet Health is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations – Medical Practice
new_roles.description:
Medical Practice Administration | Muncie Primary Care

Full-Time | On-Site | Monday–Friday

Competitive annual salary, depending on experience and qualifications, with the opportunity for an additional performance-based bonus.

45 Years of Excellence. An Exciting Future Ahead.

Founded in 1981, Muncie Primary Care is a family-owned, independent primary care practice with deep roots in East Central Indiana.

For 45 years, we've built our reputation on exceptional patient care, strong community relationships, and a commitment to independent medicine. Today, the next generation of physician leadership is carrying that legacy forward.

With a newly renovated facility and continued investments in our people, technology, and patient experience, we're excited about what's ahead.

We're proud of what we've built. We're looking for someone who's excited to help us make it even better.

*This Isn't Your Typical Office Manager Position.*

We're looking for an experienced, forward-thinking Director of Operations who can serve as the second-in-command to our physician-owner and CEO, leading the day-to-day operations of our practice while helping us build a stronger, more efficient organization for the future.

This is a true leadership position focused on developing people, improving processes, strengthening accountability, overseeing financial and operational performance, and turning ideas into action.

**What You'll Do**

1. Lead Operations and Financial Performance

* Provide overall leadership and oversight of daily practice operations, ensuring that clinical and administrative departments work together efficiently.
* Identify operational challenges, develop practical solutions, and address issues proactively before they escalate.
* Oversee operational budgets, monitor expenses, review financial performance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and profitability.
* Work with designated team members responsible for administrative functions, technology, vendor coordination, and other business operations to ensure these responsibilities are managed effectively.
* Establish clear systems for delegation, communication, follow-through, and accountability.
* Ensure appropriate processes are in place for regulatory compliance, organizational policies, and operational risk management.

2. Lead, Develop, and Support Our Team

* Build and maintain strong, positive working relationships with employees across all departments.
* Develop departmental leaders, encourage professional growth, and help employees succeed in their roles.
* Foster a workplace culture built on mutual respect, open communication, teamwork, and accountability.
* Provide coaching, performance feedback, and support with difficult conversations and conflict resolution.
* Address employee concerns and interpersonal challenges fairly, promptly, and professionally.
* Work collaboratively with our Marketing/Human Resources Manager on recruitment, employee development, retention, and performance management.
* Strengthen communication and cooperation between clinical and administrative departments.

3. Improve Systems and Use Data to Drive Decisions

* Develop, monitor, and analyze Key Result Areas (KRAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), scheduling utilization, productivity, and other operational performance measures.
* Identify inefficiencies, evaluate workflows, and implement improvements that enhance patient access, employee satisfaction, and practice performance.
* Build systems that promote consistency, clear responsibilities, effective delegation, and measurable accountability.
* Use spreadsheets, dashboards, financial information, and operational data to identify trends and guide decision-making.
* Evaluate the results of operational changes and make adjustments as needed.
* Help create an organization where problems are identified early and addressed effectively.

4. Help Shape the Future of Our Practice

* Partner directly with the physician-owner and CEO on strategic planning, organizational priorities, and practice improvement initiatives.
* Translate long-term goals into practical action plans, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
* Explore opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technology to reduce administrative burden and improve efficiency.
* Take ownership of projects from initial planning through implementation and evaluation.
* Anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and bring forward thoughtful solutions and recommendations.
* Help balance the needs of patients, providers, employees, and the business while supporting the long-term success of independent primary care.

**You might be a great candidate for this position if….**

* You're a natural leader who enjoys developing people, building relationships, and helping teams succeed.
* You build trust and respect while maintaining clear expectations and accountability.
* You're proactive, resourceful, and comfortable making decisions, solving problems, and taking ownership of outcomes.
* You communicate effectively, navigate difficult conversations professionally, and foster collaboration across departments.
* You enjoy improving processes, building efficient systems, and finding better ways to get things done.
* You're comfortable using financial information, spreadsheets, and performance metrics to guide decisions.
* You're excited about new technology, including AI and automation, and enjoy working with an engaged owner who values initiative and independent thinking.

**This Position May Not Be the Right Fit If...**

* You prefer a traditional office management role focused on completing daily administrative tasks.
* You're most comfortable waiting for direction rather than taking ownership of challenges.
* You prefer maintaining existing processes rather than finding a better way to do things.
* You find it difficult to address employee performance concerns or navigate uncomfortable conversations.
* You tend to focus on identifying problems without taking responsibility for developing and implementing solutions.
* You aren't comfortable using data, financial information, or technology to evaluate performance and guide decisions.

We recognize that no candidate will bring every skill or have every answer on day one. We're looking for someone with the leadership ability, judgment, curiosity, and initiative to learn, adapt, and grow with our practice.

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Demonstrated leadership and management experience, including supervising employees, developing teams, and overseeing complex operational workflows.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build productive working relationships.
* Experience coaching employees, addressing performance concerns, resolving conflicts, and fostering an accountable, team-oriented workplace.
* Proven ability to identify operational problems, implement solutions, and follow projects through to completion.
* Experience managing business operations, delegating responsibilities, and coordinating work across departments.
* Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, initiative, and the ability to make independent decisions.
* Comfort with technology, willingness to learn new tools, and an interest in using data to improve operational performance.

**Strongly Preferred**

* A bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, management, or a related field.

**Why Muncie Primary Care?**

We're an established, family-owned practice that values our employees, our patients, and our independence. We're proud of our history and equally excited about our future.

As our Director of Operations, you'll have:

* The opportunity to shape the systems, culture, and future direction of an established practice.
* Competitive base salary
* Opportunity for an additional performance-based bonus.
* Monday–Friday work schedule.
* Health insurance.
* Paid time off and paid holidays.
* Retirement benefits, subject to plan eligibility.

**Ready to Help Us Take the Next Step Forward?**

We're not looking for someone who has all the answers.

We're looking for someone who asks great questions, builds strong relationships, takes initiative, enjoys solving problems, and is excited about building something meaningful.

If you're an experienced leader who loves developing people, improving systems, taking ownership, and helping an organization succeed, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: From $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off

* Leadership and Initiative: Tell us about a process, system, or operational improvement you personally led. What was the problem, what did you change, and what was the result?
* Difficult Conversations: Describe a time you had to address a difficult situation with an employee or colleague involving performance, accountability, or workplace behavior. How did you approach the conversation, and what was the outcome?
* Data and Decision-Making: Tell us about a time you used data, performance metrics, or other measurable information to identify a problem or make a decision. What did you learn, and what action did you take?

identity_held_roles.description:
As **Program Director III - Quality & Customer Success**, you'll report directly to the Executive Vice President of the Intelligence Portfolio. This role oversees quality assurance and customer success. The Program Director removes delivery impediments, strengthens collaboration across teams, ensures compliance with contract requirements, and advocates for successful customer outcomes.

We know that you can't have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are **obsessed** withour people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers.

If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below!

**What you'll do:**

* Constantly monitor project progress to identify impediments early on, actively engage in resolving them, and 
 escalate issues when necessary.
* Manage and track dependencies across cross-functional teams or squads to ensure seamless collaboration and 
 timely delivery.
* Oversee and track all high-integrity commitments, ensuring they are met according to established timelines and 
 standards.
* Provide proactive visibility into project status, communicate delivery targets, commitments, and progress 
 effectively to stakeholders.
* Define, implement, and administer program deliverables to ensure full compliance with contract requirements. 
 Regularly report progress on problem resolution to senior management, highlighting any critical issues or 
 roadblocks.
* Foster a culture of team-driven decision-making and commitment, promoting trust among team members and 
 facilitating team-building events.
* Support customer meeting preparation and delivery and assist with escalations.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by senior leadership to support the overall objectives of the organization

**What you'll need to succeed:**

 

* Active TS//SCI with ability to obtain CI poly
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 10+ years of quality assurance experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership role.
* Proven success implementing and managing quality assurance processes and practices.
* Strong understanding of software development methodologies and quality assurance principles.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve delivery impediments, manage dependencies across teams, and escalate critical issues.
* Experience overseeing program deliverables to ensure compliance with contract requirements, timelines, and quality standards.
* Ability to track commitments and clearly communicate project status, delivery targets, risks, and resolution progress to stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills, including supporting customer meetings and managing escalations.
* Strategic thinking and the ability to identify and prioritize improvements in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Ability to build trust, encourage team-driven decisions, and promote accountability across cross-functional teams.

 

SALARY RANGE: $185,000- $225,000

The salary range for this position is determined based on qualifications, skills, and relevant experience. The final salary offered will be determined based on several factors including:

* The candidate's professional background and relevant work experience
* The specific responsibilities of the role and organizational needs
* Internal equity and alignment with current team compensation
* This role is also eligible for additional compensation, subject to the terms and policies of MetroStar, which may include:
* + Performance-based bonuses
 + Company-paid training and/or certifications
 + Referral bonuses

**Application Deadline:** Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until the position is filled; candidates are encouraged to apply as early as possible for full consideration.

**Additional Compensation**: This role may also be eligible for bonuses and/or additional incentives based on individual and company performance.

**Benefits**: All full-time employees are eligible to participate in our benefits programs:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Paid time off (PTO) and holidays
* Parental Leave and dependent care
* Flexible work arrangements
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee assistance and wellness programs

Like we said, **we are** big fans of our people. That's why **we offer** a generous benefits package, professional growth, and valuable time to recharge. Learn more about our company culture code and benefits. Plus, check out our accolades.

**Commitment to Non-Discrimination** 
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.

**What we want you to know:**

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

Sign up to join our newsletter here.

identity_held_roles.title: Director of Quality & Compliance
identity_held_roles.description:
**Reports to:** Executive Director

 

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality and Compliance for the PACE (Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) Program will oversee and manage all aspects of quality assurance, compliance, and regulatory adherence for the PACE program. This role ensures that the program operates in full compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, as well as upholds the highest standards of care for the elderly participants. The Director will lead efforts to continuously improve program quality, enhance participant satisfaction, and drive performance excellence across the organization.

 

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Regulatory Compliance Management:

* Ensure adherence to all PACE-related federal, state, and local regulations, including CMS (Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services) and state-specific requirements.

* Monitor and interpret updates to regulatory policies, and adjust organizational practices as necessary to remain compliant.

* Act as the primary liaison between the organization and regulatory agencies, ensuring timely reporting and response to audits, surveys, and inspections.

2. Quality Assurance and Improvement:

* In collaboration with the Medical Director develop, implement, and evaluate quality improvement initiatives to ensure high standards of care, safety, and service delivery for participants.

* Collaborate with clinical and operational teams to analyze performance metrics and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

* Oversee the development and execution of corrective action plans (CAPs) for any areas of deficiency, ensuring timely resolution.

3. Risk Management and Reporting:

* Lead risk assessment processes to identify potential compliance and quality issues, minimizing risk to the organization and participants.

* Develop and implement risk mitigation strategies, including monitoring trends, identifying patterns, and taking proactive actions.

* Ensure the organization is prepared for external audits and inspections, managing all compliance-related documentation and reporting.

4. Staff Training and Development:

* Develop and conduct ongoing training programs for staff on compliance, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

* Foster a culture of compliance and continuous improvement across the organization by leading educational initiatives and creating awareness.

* Provide guidance and support to staff on regulatory changes, quality standards, and best practices.

5. Participant Care and Satisfaction:

* Advocate for participants’ safety and satisfaction, ensuring that their rights and well-being are protected in all aspects of the program.

* Work closely with interdisciplinary teams to ensure person-centered care is at the core of all service delivery and interventions.

* Monitor and evaluate participant feedback, addressing any concerns or complaints in a timely and professional manner.

6. Leadership and Strategic Planning:

* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, contributing to the strategic direction of the PACE program.

* Collaborate with leadership to set annual goals for quality and compliance performance and develop strategies to achieve these objectives.

* Ensure alignment of quality and compliance initiatives with organizational goals and values.

7. Data Collection and Analysis:

* Oversee the collection, analysis, and reporting of quality and compliance data to track program performance and outcomes.

* Utilize data to drive decision-making and identify areas for operational improvements and resource allocation.

* Prepare reports and presentations for senior leadership and external stakeholders regarding compliance, quality, and performance metrics.

8. Technology and EMR

* Serving as the primary point of contact for EMR-related issues, providing guidance and troubleshooting support to team members.

* Leading training sessions and providing ongoing support for staff to ensure efficient use of the EMR system.

* Collaborating with IT and management teams to implement updates and resolve system issues.

* Continuously staying updated on new features and best practices for the EMR system to ensure the organization is utilizing the platform to its full potential.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, nursing, public health, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

* Minimum of 4 years of experience in quality management, compliance, or regulatory affairs in a healthcare setting, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.

* Knowledge and experience with PACE program operations and regulations (CMS and state-level).

* Strong understanding of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and compliance protocols.

* Proven track record in leading quality improvement initiatives and risk management programs.

* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with interdisciplinary teams.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive results.

* Certification in Healthcare Quality (CHCQM, CPHQ) or other relevant certifications preferred.

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to work in an office environment and attend in-person meetings.

* Occasional travel to program sites or regulatory meetings may be required.

**Work Environment:**

* A collaborative, team-oriented atmosphere within a dynamic, fast-paced healthcare environment.

* Commitment to participant-centered care and service excellence.

identity_held_roles.title: Director, Balance of Plant
identity_held_roles.description:
**Company Overview**

Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world's transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people's quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables.

**Job Summary**

Kairos Power is seeking an experienced senior engineering leader to serve as Director, Balance of Plant (Power Generation System & Turbine Island), to provide strategic and technical leadership for multidisciplinary engineering teams. This role is responsible for the technical leadership, organizational capability, and execution of the engineering teams responsible for design and deployment for Structures, Systems, and Components that convert thermal energy to electricity and provide auxiliary plant functions necessary to support reliable and efficient plant operation. The ideal candidate combines broad power plant and thermal-fluid systems expertise with demonstrated success building engineering teams, working with external partners, and delivering complex, hardware systems from concept through commissioning and operation.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership for the development and integration of balance-of-plant (BOP) Systems, such as the Heat Transport Systems interfacing with high-temperature steam Rankine cycles, Power Generation System (PGS), and auxiliary systems such as service water, treated water, and compressed air systems.
* Establish department technical direction and decision boundaries consistent with company strategy and designated technical authorities.
* Lead engineering delivery from conceptual sizing through detailed design, vendor package review, and commissioning support, owning design reviews and technical risk.
* Ensures that system and discipline leads satisfy applicable requirements, codes and standards, safety functions,and align to program
* Ensure engineering deliverables—including requirements, calculations, analyses, specifications, drawings, design reports, interface documents, and test plans—are technically sound and meet established quality and schedule requirements.
* Oversee supplier technical execution, including supplier selection, bid evaluations, equipment specifications, design reviews, technical evaluations, qualification programs, factory acceptance testing, and resolution of supplier technical issues, to ensure supplier designs and deliverables meet Kairos Power requirements.
* Oversee evaluation of BOP design and supplier changes for impacts on system interfaces, plant performance, safety, and commissioning readiness, and ensure approved changes are incorporated into the controlled technical baseline.
* Build productive relationships with external organizations while maintaining clear accountability for Kairos Power technical requirements and engineering decisions.
* Translates company strategy into measurable organizational priorities and decision principles.
* Determine and communicate explicit scope, schedule, risk, and resource tradeoffs across the organization.
* Maintain accountability for organizational outcomes and the consequences of scope, schedule, risk, and resource decisions within delegated authority, including decisions delegated to others.
* Ensure execution of strategic priorities, take corrective action when results are off track, and remove systemic barriers teams cannot resolve.
* Establish organizational technical direction and decision boundaries are established, consistent with company strategy and designated technical authorities.
* Ensure material technical and safety risk, their potential consequences, and proposed mitigations are clearly documented and communicated to the appropriate authority, with risk acceptance decisions explicitly recorded.
* Personally engage in mission-critical technical or organizational decisions, crises, external reviews, or critical deliverables when judgment materially changes the outcome.
* Build the organization and leadership pipeline required for current and future strategy, including recruitment, staffing, and leadership development.
* Hold senior leaders and technical leads accountable for team capability, succession, performance, engagement, and retention.
* Ensure systemic operational or compliance weaknesses are corrected and that improvements are sustained across the organization.
* Communicate organizational direction and tradeoffs consistently to leadership, teams, and cross-functional partners.
* Establish alignment across teams, resolve cross-functional conflicts, and escalate tradeoffs that require broader leadership decisions.
* Set the organizational tone for accountability, integrity, psychological safety, and mission stewardship, and reinforce these values through visible decisions, resource choices, recognition, and corrective action.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent
* 15+ years of progressively responsible engineering experience involving power generation, thermal-fluid systems, process systems, nuclear systems, or other complex industrial systems.
* 7+years of progressive engineering leadership experience managing engineering teams with multiple engineering disciplines.
* Experience managing engineering managers or technical leads with accountability for outcomes across multiple teams and work sites.
* Experience working with suppliers, OEMs, engineering contractors, or other external technical organizations.
* Experience leading technical development and qualification of major equipment through external suppliers or OEMs.
* Experience supporting construction, commissioning, startup, or operation of complex power generation or industrial facilities.
* Experience with integrated power plant systems, including modern high-temperature steam Rankine cycles and the interactions between heat transport, power conversion, auxiliary systems, and plant infrastructure.
* Strong systems thinking with the ability to identify and resolve technical issues that cross traditional engineering and organizational boundaries.
* Lead and support recruitment and staffing requirements of group.
* Proactive, organized, adaptable, and able to thrive in fast-paced, multi-tasked environments.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Knowledge of integrated power plant architecture, thermal-fluid systems, power generation systems, auxiliary systems, major plant equipment, and their interfaces, including familiarity with various steam generator technologies such as Heat Recovery Steam Generators and molten salt steam generators.
* Knowledge of equipment procurement, supplier engineering, manufacturing, testing, installation, commissioning, and lifecycle considerations associated with complex industrial systems.
* Skill in leading and developing multidisciplinary engineering organizations and holding teams accountable for technical and execution outcomes.
* Skill in translating program objectives into engineering strategies, priorities, resource plans, and measurable commitments.
* Skill in technical decision-making, trade studies, risk assessment, problem solving, and resolution of complex cross-system issues.
* Ability to establish clear accountability while empowering managers, technical leads, and responsible engineers to make decisions at the appropriate organizational level.
* Ability to operate effectively in a first-of-a-kind environment characterized by technical uncertainty, evolving requirements, and competing priorities.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues, uncertainties, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders to support informed decisions.

**Physical Demands**

* Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods
* Moving about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another
* Repetitive assembly operations of manufacturing test fixtures and test setups in collaboration with engineering and manufacturing teams
* Communicating with others to exchange information

**Environmental Conditions**

* General office environment
* Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned
* High-concentration, demanding and fast-paced
* Prototyping/Test Environments
* Manufacturing/Industrial Environments

**Safety and PPE**

* Reading and interpreting hazardous warning signs
* Reporting issues with equipment or unsafe conditions
* Wearing proper personal protective equipment (PPE), to include face mask, face shields, gloves, safety shoes, and other PPE as required

**Travel**

* Some travel may be required (up to 25%)

**Additional Requirements**

* Occasionally requires working weekends
* Occasionally requires schedule flexibility
* Occasionally requires extended hours to support launch and critical project timelines

#LI-Remote

**About our Benefits**

We know that we have some of the most talented and dedicated employees, and we believe in rewarding them accordingly. If you work here, full-time employees (excludes interns) expect to have access to the benefits below:

* Competitive compensation packages
* Medical, dental and vision benefits for employees and their dependents
* Paid Vacation
* 401(k) and pre-tax health insurance, dependent care, and commuter benefits (FSA)

Kairos Power is committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities where we do business. Kairos Power is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We actively welcome people of different experiences, abilities, and perspectives.

Kairos Power participates in E-Verify.

Candidates only, no recruiters or agencies please.

To work in this facility, you need to be authorized by the Department of Energy to access Part 810-controlled information. Foreign nationals who are citizens of countries that are not on the Department of Energy's general authorization list (link below) are not permitted to work in our facility unless the Department of Energy issues an export control license to the company to permit that individual to have access to Part 810-controlled information. identity_held_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing (Robot Production)
identity_held_roles.description:
**About Genesis**
=================

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration, and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We are French and American by birth and global by nature. We are backed by partners who share our vision, including Eclipse, Khosla Ventures, Bpifrance, and HSG, alongside Eric Schmidt, Xavier Niel, Daniela Rus, and Vladlen Koltun. Our people work across the Bay Area and Europe, building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model, and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

**The role**
------------

We build general-purpose robots, and next year we start building them in volume. You will be the manufacturing leader who takes the robot from engineering builds to production. Our CA facility is where new products are introduced: the process is designed, the first stations are built and proven, and the technicians are trained there. Volume production runs with a manufacturing partner, on their floor or on ours with their people, and you own the process in both cases. You design how the robot gets built, you lead the engineers and technicians who prove it, and you own the quality gate that decides when a unit leaves.

This is hands-on work. You design the first station, write the first work instruction, and bring the partner's team up to our standard. What exists today: an engineering build process with our design team, a production partner, a bill of materials and a plan. What does not exist yet is the production process, and that is the job.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Design the production process: layout and cycle time, line balancing, station and fixture design, end-of-line test and calibration, material flow.
* Capacity planning: stations, equipment, people and hours by build phase, from the first units to rate, and the plan to add capacity ahead of demand.
* Specify, source and commission fixtures, tooling and test equipment: requirements, RFQ with Supply Chain, acceptance at the vendor and on the floor.
* Own process documentation under revision control: work instructions with photos and video, PFMEA, control plans, inspection plans, SOPs; keep the manufacturing BOM aligned with the engineering BOM and run engineering changes through to the floor.
* Run the transfer from engineering builds to production: pilot builds, DFM and DFA feedback with the authority to push back, build readiness reviews at each phase gate, release to volume.
* Package the process so it can be copied: one documented set of stations, fixtures, test, instructions and training that a partner's floor can run to the same yield as ours.
* Build and lead the team: manufacturing engineers, test engineers and technicians; hiring pace, training and certification, trainer capacity, shift structure as volume grows.
* Own the quality gate: first-pass yield, defect capture, root cause (8D, SPC, DOE where it earns its keep), closed-loop feedback to engineering and suppliers; nothing ships that quality has not passed.
* Partner with Supply Chain on clear-to-build so no unit starts without a complete kit, and with the manufacturing partner so their team runs our process to our standard.
* Stand up the systems as we grow: traceability by serial, MES-lite at first, then the real thing; the weekly numbers (yield, hours per unit, cost per unit, downtime, schedule adherence) and the readout to leadership.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* You have taken a complex electromechanical product from prototype through pilot to volume and designed the process yourself, not inherited it. Robots, vehicles, drones, medical devices, industrial equipment all count.
* You have transferred a process to a contract manufacturer and held them to your standard.
* Strong manufacturing engineering foundation: time studies, line balancing, capacity planning, fixture and tooling design, test strategy, PFMEA and control plans, lean and continuous improvement; CAD and GD&T fluency.
* You have hired and trained technicians, written certification criteria, and know that trained people are the real constraint on throughput.
* You have run a quality gate and held it under schedule pressure.
* You are on the floor every day and rigorous in the data.
* 8 or more years in manufacturing engineering or production, with time in a mature organization so you know what good looks like at scale, and 3 or more years leading people.
* Bonus: actuators, gearboxes or precision assemblies; PLM, MES and ERP implementation; product safety certification processes.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

Production and lab environments; travel to partner sites, up to 25%.

**Why this role**
-----------------

You build the way our robots get built, from the first station to rate, and the process and the team that do it are yours.

**How we work**
---------------

We are always looking for people who are driven to work on hard problems and want to shape what the world will look like in ten years. A few of the values that guide us:

* **Limitless ambition.** We hold ourselves to the highest bar in everything we build.
* **Relentless urgency.** Iterate faster, learn faster. Time is the denominator.
* **Type-2 Fun.** Take the work seriously, not yourself. Embrace the grind and find joy in the struggle.
* **Radical transparency.** Candid communication builds trust, and direct feedback drives growth.
* **Multiculturalism.** We come from across the world. Be curious. Meet people on their terms.
* **Team over ego.** Help others, share context, and win as a team.
* **A joyful journey.** We take pride in the craft.

existing_roles.title: Director, Quality Engineering and Automation -Information technology
existing_roles.description:
Overview:

ServiceLink is seeking an experienced Director of Quality Engineering and Automation to lead our quality engineering transformation. This leader will be responsible for defining and executing the enterprise quality strategy, modernizing test automation capabilities, establishing quality governance standards, and driving engineering-wide quality improvements.

This role is not a traditional QA management position focused solely on test execution. The Director will serve as the organization’s quality engineering leader, responsible for building scalable automation capabilities, establishing meaningful quality metrics, and influencing software quality outcomes across Engineering, Product, and Release organizations.

The ideal candidate combines deep quality engineering expertise with strong organizational leadership, executive communication skills, and a proven ability to drive meaningful change in highly matrixed environments. Success in this role requires the ability to influence decisions through data, credibility, partnership, and quality leadership rather than direct organizational authority.

ServiceLink is modernizing the mortgage services industry through AI-accelerated engineering, intelligent automation, and next-generation software delivery practices. We empower the nation’s top lenders and financial institutions with advanced technology, data-driven insights, and high-velocity product development models.

As we continue to scale our technology platforms, we are investing in a modern Quality Engineering organization focused on automation, quality governance, engineering excellence, and continuous delivery. Our goal is to transform quality from a downstream testing activity into an engineering capability embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.

**This is a hybrid role, and will be required to work in-office at our Plano, TX office at least 3 days per week. Candidates must be located within reasonable commuting distance of this office and be willing to work in-office on a regular basis.**

**Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require sponsorship for employment visa status now or in the future.**

A DAY IN THE LIFE

In this role, you will…

* Lead quality engineering transformation
* Own enterprise test automation strategy
* Establish quality governance and risk management policies and procedures
* Drive engineering quality excellence
* Influence cross-functional release and product outcomes
* Establish quality metrics and executive reporting
* Lead and develop the Quality Engineering organization

Success Measures

* Automated coverage of critical business workflows.
* Reduction in manual regression testing effort.
* Improved release predictability and confidence.
* Reduction in escaped production defects.
* Increased adoption of shift-left quality practices.
* Expanded developer ownership of quality.
* Enhanced visibility into quality trends and release readiness risks.
* Increased executive confidence in quality governance and software delivery outcomes.

WHO YOU ARE

You possess …

* 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality, quality engineering, software engineering, or related technology leadership roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality engineering organizations in complex enterprise software environments.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale test automation and quality transformation initiatives.
* Experience building and scaling automation frameworks and engineering quality practices.
* Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience implementing API, integration, end-to-end, performance, and regression testing strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Experience establishing quality metrics, executive scorecards, and data-driven governance models.
* Strong understanding of risk management, release readiness, and quality governance practices.
* Experience managing distributed teams and complex organizational change efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering and testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar technologies.

Responsibilities:

1. Lead Quality Engineering Transformation

* Define and execute a multi-year quality engineering strategy aligned with ServiceLink’s technology and business objectives.
* Transform the organization from a predominantly manual testing model to an automation-first quality engineering approach.
* Establish scalable operating models, standards, and best practices across quality engineering functions.
* Evaluate and implement AI-assisted testing capabilities where they provide measurable business value.
* Continuously improve testing effectiveness, release confidence, and overall software quality.
* Develop a strategic roadmap that reduces manual regression testing effort while improving coverage and reliability.

2. Own Enterprise Test Automation Strategy

* Define and execute automation strategies spanning unit, API, integration, end-to-end, performance, and regression testing.
* Build and maintain modern automation frameworks supporting multiple product portfolios and technology stacks.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive testing activities and reduce release-cycle effort.
* Establish automation standards, coding practices, and framework governance.
* Drive automation adoption across engineering teams and development pipelines.
* Ensure automation investments directly support business outcomes through measurable reductions in manual testing effort

and improved release quality.

3. Establish Quality Governance and Risk Management

* Define enterprise quality standards, testing policies, and release readiness criteria.
* Develop risk-based testing frameworks that focus resources on the highest-value business scenarios.
* Provide objective assessments of release readiness and software quality risks.
* Establish processes for identifying, documenting, communicating, and escalating quality concerns.
* Lead post-release reviews and quality retrospectives to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
* Create clear mechanisms for risk visibility and executive decision support.

4. Drive Engineering Quality Excellence

* Partner with software engineering leaders to embed quality throughout the SDLC.
* Champion shift-left testing practices and developer ownership of quality.
* Promote increased use of automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive adoption of engineering practices that improve code quality, testability, maintainability, and system reliability.
* Collaborate with architecture and development teams to improve overall product quality and reduce defect introduction

rates.

* Influence engineering decisions through quality metrics, technical insights, and continuous improvement recommendations.

5. Influence Cross-Functional Release and Product Outcomes

* Build strong working relationships across Product Management, Release Management, Engineering, Operations, and

Support organizations.

* Serve as a trusted advisor on quality, testing strategy, release readiness, and operational risk.
* Influence planning, prioritization, and release decisions through data-driven recommendations and quality insights.
* Ensure stakeholders understand the quality implications of scope changes, late-stage modifications, and release decisions.
* Foster organizational alignment around quality objectives and customer experience outcomes.
* Facilitate constructive discussions regarding risk, readiness, and delivery trade-offs.

6. Establish Quality Metrics and Executive Reporting

* Define and maintain enterprise quality KPIs and executive dashboards.
* Track and communicate trends related to:

o Escaped defects

o Automation coverage

o Regression testing effort

o Test effectiveness

o Production incidents

o Release quality

o Customer-impacting defects

* Use quantitative analysis to identify improvement opportunities and support investment decisions.
* Provide executive leadership with clear visibility into quality trends, risks, and organizational progress.

7. Lead and Develop the Quality Engineering Organization

* Build, mentor, and develop high-performing quality engineering teams.
* Create career paths for automation engineers, quality engineers, and quality leaders.
* Attract and retain top quality engineering talent.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Ensure organizational structures support both immediate delivery needs and long-term quality transformation goals.

Qualifications:

Required

* 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality, quality engineering, software engineering, or related technology leadership roles.
* 5+ years of experience leading quality engineering organizations in complex enterprise software environments.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale test automation and quality transformation initiatives.
* Experience building and scaling automation frameworks and engineering quality practices.
* Strong understanding of modern SDLC practices, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience implementing API, integration, end-to-end, performance, and regression testing strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Experience establishing quality metrics, executive scorecards, and data-driven governance models.
* Strong understanding of risk management, release readiness, and quality governance practices.
* Experience managing distributed teams and complex organizational change efforts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business audiences.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering and testing tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar technologies.

Preferred

* Experience leading quality engineering organizations undergoing significant automation transformation.
* Background in highly regulated industries such as financial services, mortgage, banking, insurance, healthcare, or fintech.
* Experience implementing quality engineering practices within Agile and product-oriented delivery models.
* Knowledge of modern test automation platforms, quality engineering frameworks, and observability tools.
* Experience supporting large-scale digital transformation initiatives.

existing_roles.description:
**Corporate Overview**

Aluris Sciences is a contract manufacturing organization (CMO) headquartered in Carlsbad, CA with over 50,000 square feet of manufacturing space. The company is dedicated to serving highly innovative companies in the life sciences, diagnostics, drug-device, and combination product industries. Aluris is a full-service, cost-effective partner, providing complete solutions across technical transfer, formulation, filling, lyophilization, assembly, and final kitting of reagents, consumables, and combination products. Aluris provides quality and regulatory expertise to assure the highest in quality manufacturing and supply chain excellence.

**Position Overview**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) is responsible for leading and managing the company’s quality assurance and regulatory compliance programs. This role ensures that all quality systems align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices, maintaining compliance with ISO-13485, ISO 14971, GMP/GLP, QSR, 21 CFR 820.30, and other relevant medical device (IVD) regulations.

The Director of QA will work closely with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and implement strategic quality initiatives, oversee external audits and regulatory inspections, and drive continuous improvement across the organization. This role also involves coaching and mentoring staff, managing compliance metrics, and supporting client engagements by serving as the company’s quality systems representative.

Success in this position requires strong leadership, a deep understanding of quality regulations, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build and maintain a culture of compliance and operational excellence.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and assist in performing all tasks necessary to achieve the organization's mission and help execute growth
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to formulation and execute the
* strategic vision.
* Work with the Vice President of Quality and Regulatory to develop and actively manage the company's quality system consistent with the culture and intent of the company
* Oversee and coordinate the quality management systems implementation.
* Accountable for maintaining a state of compliance to f CFR 21 820, 210 and 211.
* Act as the "management representative" within the quality plan.
* Will formulate and lead the management team to maintain ISO 13485 compliance.
* Will assist the leadership in implementation of the technology and process capability roadmap with specific emphasis on validation (10/OQ) and documentation support.
* Will be involved in strategic planning, evaluation, and professional development initiatives.
* Will recruit, hire and manage a motivated and highly talented staff of quality and regulatory professionals
* Provide leadership and/or support as needed throughout the organization, specifically all activities associated with bill of materials structuring, part numbering, SKU attributes, set up, training and quality management systems.
* Represent the quality systems acumen and quality systems capabilities of the company.
* Support all clients engagements as the quality system voice of the company and our capabilities
* Will actively work with the VP of Manufacturing to solve challenges in the production environment related to workflow, internal audits, material dispositions (MRP) and process changes/deviations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Successfully served in a similar capacity in a contract manufacturing company for a highly regulated market, preferably the life science/pharmaceutical environment.
* Proven credibility as a Quality leader in the life science manufacturing environment.
* Experience and familiarity in reagent formulation, filling and finishing activities with several years of directly related accountability for quality in this form of manufacturing.
* Proven track record of exceptional performance in these FDA regulated environments with audit experience from the FDA and clients
* FDA rapport and relationships are strongly desired
* A familiarity with Lean Manufacturing cultures in a volume production facility
* Experience and proven results in driving process/technology validation efforts.
* Experience and expertise in communication exchanges with clients during tours, meetings, and audits.
* Consistently exhibited through their actions, decisions, and interactions (internally and externally), the highest standards of ethics and integrity.
* The ability to create, direct and implement corporate objectives in an environment with a high sense of urgency
* A proven capability to generate shareholder value
* Negotiation skills to maximize value in client/regulatory body discussions
* Experience building compliance and standardization of processes (building a scalable organization).
* Experience participating in ERP implementations managing and driving documentation control, bills of materials, routings and workflows.
* A track record of recruiting exceptional talent within the economic constraints of a small company.
* A "hands-on" management style with the interpersonal skills required to build a successful team and the desire to motivate, inspire and develop management team members
* High intelligence with effective analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and listening skills.
* A proactive style using initiative and perseverance in order to bring about meaningful change.
* Demonstrated high energy.
* Team Player.

**What to Expect:**

This is a full-time, 100% on-site position based in Carlsbad, CA, with a Monday–Friday schedule and 8-hour workdays, excluding meal breaks. Overtime, weekend, and holiday work may be required as business needs arise.

The position offers a flexible start time between 6:00 a.m. and 9:30 a.m.; however, employees are expected to maintain a consistent schedule. Any exceptions to the established schedule must be approved in advance by the manager.

**What We Offer/Compensation**

At Aluris Sciences, LLC. we value our employees and are proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial future. Eligible employees enjoy:

**Health & Wellness**

* Medical, dental and vision coverage
* Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options
* Company-paid life insurance
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage

**Financial & Time Off**

* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid vacation
* California Paid Sick Leave
* Paid company holidays

**Additional Benefits**

* Employee Assistance Program
* Voluntary and supplemental benefit options

The pay range for this position is $195,000 - $205,000 annually. The final compensation offered will be based on a variety of job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, education, experience, certifications, and other relevant qualifications.

Aluris Sciences, LLC. is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age or disability, or any other class protected by Federal, State or local laws.
