* Oversee quality assurance processes, including product testing, inspections, and audits to maintain high-quality standards.

* Create and enforce food safety and quality policies and procedures across all operations.

* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal food safety regulations, including FDA, USDA, and HACCP standards.

* Identify and manage food safety risks, implementing corrective actions and preventive measures.

* Develop and deliver training programs to educate employees on food safety and quality assurance practices.

* Monitor and analyze food safety and quality metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement the best practices.

* Lead and mentor the food safety and quality assurance team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.

* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends as needed.

*Aerospace is at a turning point — costs are rising, supply chains are strained, and old ways of building can't keep up. At Neon Aero, we're breaking that mold. We move fast, think big, and combine start-up agility with aerospace expertise to design, build, and scale aircraft in ways the industry has never seen. Our team leverages automation, AI-driven tools, and a fully connected digital backbone to accelerate innovation and reduce barriers to production.*

*Here, you won't just take a job — you'll help reinvent how the world flies. If you're ready to solve complex problems, push technology further, and work alongside some of the brightest minds in aerospace, this is your chance to make a real impact.*

Neon is looking for an Aerospace Quality Director to help build the quality systems, team, and operating discipline needed to take parts and assemblies from prototype into production. This role will lead the quality function across development, manufacturing, supplier quality, and production readiness, ensuring the company can scale with strong process control, repeatability, and compliance. You will play a key role in helping a growing aerospace organization move from fast iteration to reliable production without losing technical rigor.

### **Why This Role Matters**

* Help shape how a growing company scales from prototype builds to stable production.
* Build the quality foundation needed for repeatable manufacturing, stronger yields, and fewer escapes.
* Partner directly with engineering and manufacturing to improve design transfer, process readiness, and production execution.
* Lead the systems and team that drive inspection discipline, nonconformance control, corrective action, and supplier quality.
* Influence how production processes are defined, controlled, and improved as volume and complexity grow.
* Operate in a fast-paced environment where quality decisions directly affect hardware readiness, customer confidence, and operational scale.
* Work across office, lab, and production settings with direct visibility into how quality impacts the business.

### **What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, manufacturing, aerospace, or a related technical field; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Experience managing a growing department of direct reports responsible for all aspects of product and process quality.
* Significant progressive experience in aerospace quality, manufacturing quality, supplier quality, or quality systems leadership.
* Experience helping move parts, assemblies, or hardware programs from prototype into production.
* Experience building or improving quality systems in a growing manufacturing organization.
* Strong background in inspection planning, process controls, nonconformance management, and corrective action.
* Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain teams to improve quality and production readiness.
* Experience with supplier quality management and supplier issue resolution.
* Strong problem-solving skills, judgment, communication, and ability to drive accountability across teams.
* Ability to work across office, lab, and production environments.
* Ability to support periods of increased workload tied to builds, ramp activity, and issue resolution.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
* May be required to meet export control, ITAR, confidentiality, or site access requirements.

#### **Preferred**

* Advanced degree in a relevant technical discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* ASQ certification or equivalent quality credential.
* Experience with first article inspection, process validation, control plans, or production quality planning tools.
* Experience in high-growth aerospace, defense, or advanced hardware manufacturing environments.
* Experience building quality organizations during production scale-up.

### **Why Join Us**

We have integrated a differentiated set of technologies, end-to-end services, and industry-leading manufacturing expertise to develop advanced therapies faster and more efficiently.

  

**The Role**

The Senior Director, Quality Control leads all Quality Control operations at ElevateBio's Waltham site, including QC Analytical Technologies (QCAT), QC Analytics, Testing Core, QC Microbiology, QC Raw Materials, and QC Logistics. The role is accountable for safe, compliant, inspection-ready, and predictable execution across a seven-day operating model, including product release and in-process testing, STAT support to Manufacturing, environmental and microbiological testing, raw material disposition, stability support, sample management, and analytical lifecycle enablement. The Senior Director establishes the QC operating strategy, capacity and resource plan, performance system, and leadership model required to meet manufacturing, client, and business commitments while sustaining laboratory excellence and data integrity.

**Here's What You'll Do**

**QC Strategy and Leadership**

* Lead the integrated QC organization, operating model, objectives, decision rights, talent strategy, and capability roadmap.
* Develop QC management and technical leaders while aligning headcount, seven-day coverage, facilities, equipment, systems, operating expense, and capital with demand.

**Predictable QC Operations and Laboratory Excellence**

* Own safe, compliant, and predictable execution of product release and in-process testing, environmental and microbiological monitoring, raw material disposition, stability, sample management, and client commitments.
* Ensure reliable seven-day operations through capacity planning, schedule control, tiered daily management, performance review, and timely escalation and recovery.
* Partner with Manufacturing to align readiness, prioritization, and rapid execution of STAT in-process samples within required decision windows.
* Drive laboratory excellence through standard work, right-first-time execution, efficient review and reporting, backlog control, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.

**Analytical Technologies and Lifecycle Enablement**

* Provide leadership oversight for QCAT, including client technical interface, technology and method transfer, qualification and validation, method lifecycle management, equipment qualification, controls and critical reagents, and Digital QC.
* Ensure effective utilization of shared QC Resources, handoffs between QCAT and operational laboratories through clear readiness criteria, accountability, sustainable capacity, and post-implementation monitoring.

**Quality, Compliance, and Partnership**

* Ensure QC activities meet cGMP, approved procedures, specifications, quality agreements, data-integrity expectations, and regulatory commitments.
* Provide senior oversight of laboratory events, atypical or out-of-specification results, deviations, investigations, CAPAs, changes, risks, and inspection readiness.
* Represent QC in client governance, audits, regulatory inspections, release-readiness reviews, and escalations; communicate performance, constraints, risks, and recovery plans clearly.

**Position Title:** Director of Quality Assurance

**Department/Area:** Quality Assurance

**Reports to:** Senior Director of Quality Assurance

**Employment Status:** Full-Time; Non-Union

**EXCELLENT BENEFITS PACKAGE:**

* **Earn an additional week of paid time off including floating holidays, and personal time! Plus,**
* **13 paid holidays per year, and paid sick time!**
* **Company paid Life Insurance,**
* **Company paid Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance,**
* **401K,**
* **Opt-in benefits available: Pet Insurance, Employee/Spouse/Child Life Insurance, and Long Term Disability,**
* **Plus, Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance!**

  

**Organization Overview:**

Sound Community Services, Inc. (SCSI) is a private, not-for-profit organization dedicated to educating, assisting, and supporting individuals with persistent mental illness and substance use disorders. We work tirelessly to create a culture and environment in which recovery and wellness are possible.

**Position Overview:**

The Director of Quality Assurance (QA) oversees all agency activities related to quality improvement, compliance, data integrity, and regulatory preparedness for the agency. This position provides leadership in the development, implementation, and monitoring of systems that support clinical excellence, consumer rights, performance measurement, and regulatory compliance. The Director plays a critical role in the maintenance, configuration, and optimization of the Electronic Health Record (EHR); oversees required state reporting; maintains the centralized repository of all Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS) reported data; and ensures accurate and timely data submission. This role also leads the agency’s preparation for external audits (ex., Commission on Accreditation of Rehabilitation Facilities (CARF), Department of Public Health (DPH), DMHAS), coordinates customer satisfaction activities, and serves as the agency’s Client Rights Officer.

This position is responsible for the monitoring and analyzing of processes to meet Fidelity and contractual requirements across the agency. Ongoing analysis of health care information obtained from a variety of sources, including patient care, financial, and demographic data is necessary. This role involves the development and preparation of information for state reporting and organizational best practices. This position will maintain repository of all state reported data for all DMHAS programs. A heavy importance is placed on collaborating with program leaders across the agency, ensuring accuracy of data reported and driving agency performance.

**Essential Functions**

**Department Leadership, Training, and Support**

* Directly supervise two (2) employees in the Quality Assurance department and serve as backup to staff as needed.
* Provide Daily Living Activities Functional Assessment (DLA-20), program specific documentation, and recovery planning training to the agency.
* Train employees and monitor compliance across programs with state reporting requirements.
* Function as an internal information expert to the entire management team when special and critical quality issues occur.
* Consult with senior leadership to resolve quality, service, and efficiency problems.

**State Reporting, Data, and Surveys**

* Facilitate and coordinate annual DMHAS Consumer Satisfaction Surveys and quarterly CARF Satisfaction surveys.
* Provide DMHAS Data Performance System (DDaP) data and informational support to other departments, including DDaP 101 supervisor training, share DMHAS information with leadership, and present quarterly and annual DMHAS Report Cards to leadership.

**Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Systems Support**

* Triage QA tickets. Issues include, but are not limited to, document management, on/off-boarding, medical staff onboarding, system outages, etc.
* Facilitate within the EHR the build and support of procedures, forms, and form development; implement training to identified employees.
* Foster ongoing support to assigned programs and serve as a liaison between staff and vendors for effective responses to users’ needs.

**Audit Readiness, Compliance, and Quality Improvement**

* Provide support to programs in preparation for routine external audits, including CARF survey, fidelity reviews, and Department of Public Health licensing.
* Facilitate completion of all corrective action plans and audit follow-up, including quarterly and annual program compliance reviews.
* Monitor and assist with corrections and work with programs to identify and resolve root causes as needed.
* Ensure compliance with SCSI’s policies, quality assurance programs, and safety; ensure EHR compliance with regulatory agencies like DMHAS, DPH, CARF, etc.
* Participate in quality improvement initiatives.
* Serve as the agency’s Client Rights Officer (CRO), observing and adhering to the role outlined by DMHAS.

**Agency Participation and Policy Compliance**

* Participate in all agency activities pertaining to health and safety, training, drills, etc.
* Adhere to SCSI policies and procedures.

**Physical Requirements**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls, and climb stairs. The employee frequently is required to walk, talk and/or hear; speaking and hearing ability sufficient to communicate effectively by phone or in person at normal volumes; vision adequate to read correspondence, computer screen, forms, etc. The employee is occasionally required to stand and climb or balance. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this position include the ability to adjust focus. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong understanding of Connecticut DMHAS standards, documentation requirements, and reporting systems (including DDaP).
* Demonstrated ability to supervise, lead, and coach staff.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
* Demonstrated technology and software application skills; ability to learn new software packages; highly skilled in office productivity software (e.g., Word, PowerPoint, Excel, email).
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to be proactive, flexible, and customer service focused and to work effectively with others.

**Qualifications**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree required, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.

**Minimum experience:** Experience working with electronic health record system, i.e., CareLogic; experience providing training; and experience with accreditation standards such as CARF, DMHAS, DPH, or similar regulatory bodies.

**Preferred qualifications:** Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, Psychology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field. Masters degree preferred.

**Preferred license:** Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC)

**Driver’s license requirement:** A current valid driver’s license is required.

**Background check, credentialing, health screening, or other employment requirements:** Successful completion of required background checks and any other applicable agency employment requirements.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religious creed, age, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, marital status, civil union status, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, present or past history of mental disability, intellectual disability, learning disability, physical disability, including but not limited to blindness, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, status as a victim of domestic violence, status as a victim of sexual assault, status as a victim of trafficking in persons, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

**Other Duties**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Employees may be required to perform other job-related duties as assigned.

existing_roles.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is hiring a Director of Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Quality to build and lead the team responsible for the technical relationship with our supplier base, from first sketch through high-volume production, and for the quality systems that ensure everything that arrives at our factories meets spec. This role reports into our VP, Global Supply Chain and brings together two functions that have to move as one: the engineers who industrialize our components and equipment, and the quality systems and team that hold our suppliers accountable once they are producing.

Form's 85% domestically sourced supply chain was built for a battery chemistry with no existing supplier base, which means the industrialization playbook and the quality systems we need are still being written. You will set that standard: rigorous enough to protect a product with a 100-hour duration promise, and practical enough to work with suppliers who are learning our process alongside us. You will fly high enough to set the strategy and the org, and go deep enough to sit in a root cause review when it matters.  
  
*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Lead Form's Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Supplier Quality organization, growing a team of engineers embedded across battery materials, components, and equipment categories.
* Own the end-to-end industrialization journey for direct materials and made-to-spec components, from design-for-manufacturability review and supplier selection through tooling qualification and sustaining production support.
* Build and own Form's supplier quality management system, including PPAP, APQP, PFMEA, control plans, and SCAR/8D corrective action processes, calibrated for a novel battery chemistry with no legacy supply base to borrow from.
* Set the technical bar for supplier selection and qualification, partnering with Global Supply Managers to ensure our sourcing strategy is backed by suppliers who can deliver on cost, quality, and schedule.
* Own supplier process capability and yield performance, coordinating with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, and Reliability teams to drive root cause analysis and corrective action when issues surface.
* Develop the roadmap and staffing plan for quality systems aligned to relevant standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949) at a scale and stage appropriate to where Form is today and where we are headed.
* Represent supplier technical and quality readiness within the Product Development Process, ensuring every component and supplier is qualified ahead of commercial scale.
* Partner with Supply Chain leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to align supplier roadmaps with Form's build plan and deployment targets.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Materials Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of experience in supplier industrialization, quality, or manufacturing engineering, including at least 5 years in a people leadership role building and scaling a team.
* Demonstrated expertise across DFM/DFA, PPAP, APQP, FMEA, SPC, and structured root cause methodologies (8D, 5 Whys).
* Experience building quality and industrialization systems from the ground up, ideally in a hardware, energy, or battery environment without an established supplier base to lean on.
* Strong technical fluency to go deep with engineers and suppliers, paired with the executive presence to represent risk, tradeoffs, and strategy to senior leadership.
* Comfort operating across the full arc from early design concept through high-volume production and sustaining support, with the judgment to know which problems need a system and which need a phone call.

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

Description:

**Lead Strategy. Drive Performance. Shape the Future.**

KSP Group, Inc/Jensen Metal Products is seeking a hands-on manufacturing leader to drive operational excellence, strengthen accountability, improve execution, and build scalable operating systems across our manufacturing businesses. This is not a corporate executive role designed to lead from a conference room.

We are looking for a proven change agent who is equally comfortable reviewing financial results, leading daily operational reviews, solving production challenges on the shop floor, and developing frontline leaders.

This is a multi-site position, initially focused on Jensen Metal Products and Jensen Powder Finishers. The successful candidate will build the structure, discipline, and performance culture needed to support long-term growth across KSP Group.

The ideal candidate brings deep experience in fabrication and manufacturing environments, a strong operational and financial mindset, and a proven ability to lead teams through growth and transformation.

**About KSP Group**

KSP Group is a family-owned organization with a diverse portfolio of manufacturing and consumer product companies

* **Jensen Metal Products** – Custom metal fabrication, welding, machining, laser cutting, engineering and contract manufacturing solutions (Racine, WI)
* **Jensen Powder Finishers** – Advanced powder coating and finishing services (Sturtevant, WI)
* **Jensen Castings** – Manufacturer of premium GFRC concrete fire features (Richland Center, WI)
* **Real Flame** – A leading designer and manufacturer of fireplaces, fire tables, and outdoor living products sold through major retailers across North America (Union Grove, WI)

Together, our companies are built on innovation, craftsmanship, customer partnerships, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a visible impact, influence company strategy, and help shape the future of multiple growing businesses.

**What You'll Do**

Executive Strategic & Business Leadership

* Lead the development and execution of operational strategies that support long-term business objectives and growth initiatives
* Partner with executive leadership to establish priorities, allocate resources, and drive enterprise-wide operational improvements
* Lead plant leadership teams in defining strategic direction, performance goals, and key operational initiatives
* Identify opportunities for automation, process optimization, capacity expansion, and operational scalability

Financial & Operational Performance

* Own operational performance and P&L results across assigned manufacturing operations
* Develop departmental budgets, monitor spending, and ensure responsible management of operational resources
* Analyze manufacturing costs, labor efficiency, productivity metrics, and operating expenses to drive profitability
* Report on operational performance and improvement initiatives to executive leadership

Manufacturing Operations & Continuous Improvement

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across fabrication, welding, machining, powder coating, assembly, engineering, and support functions
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, 5S, root cause problem solving, and waste reduction efforts
* Improve throughput, quality, safety, delivery performance, and overall operational efficiency
* Lead cross-functional projects focused on sustainable operational gains and measurable business results

Leadership & Culture

* Build, coach, and develop high-performing operational leadership teams
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Promote employee engagement while creating a safe, quality-focused work environment

Requirements:

**What We're Looking For**

* Demonstrated success leading directly from the manufacturing floor, including personal involvement in:
* Production planning and scheduling
* Labor performance management
* Quality improvement initiatives
* Corrective action processes
* Maintenance and equipment planning
* Capital investment justification
* Safety and operational accountability
* Frontline leadership development
* Proven track record of transforming entrepreneurial manufacturing organizations into process-driven, scalable operations through both strategic leadership and active engagement with frontline teams
* Ability to establish accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy
* Strong understanding of fabrication, welding, machining, finishing, assembly, materials management, and manufacturing cost drivers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, or related field, preferred
* Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience
* Lean Six Sigma certification
* Experience within both contract manufacturing and consumer products environments
* ERP/MRP system experience

**Travel Requirements**

* Regular travel between KSP Group facilities, including Jensen Metal Products, Jensen Powder Finishers, Jensen Castings, and Real Flame locations
* Frequent presence on manufacturing floors to support leadership teams, operational reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives
* Approximately 25-50% travel, primarily within Wisconsin and company operating locations
* Occasional overnight travel for customer visits, supplier meetings, strategic initiatives, and industry events

**About Us**

Jensen Metal Products is a metal fabrication business with over 100 years of experience serving the Midwest and surrounding regions with custom, quality sheet metal parts and assemblies. With a broad range of manufacturing capabilities, we produce a diverse portfolio of products, including our own line of fireplaces, which has been in production since 1970. We serve many types of businesses including the agricultural, retail, energy and healthcare fields. From engineering to packaging, our goal is to be a one-stop shop that exceeds our customers’ expectations for quality, delivery, great customer service and cost. At Jensen Metal Products we pride ourselves on having strong, long-lasting relationships with our employees and customers. We welcome you to join our team!

* Competitive base salary plus profit sharing
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with multiple plan options (HDHP and copay), FSA benefits, and the ability to use your existing HSA
* Company-funded medical deductible reimbursement — up to $1,000 (individual) / $2,000 (family)
* 401(k) with company match up to 4%
* Life and disability insurance and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Paid time off and company holidays
* Annual Safety PPE Reimbursement
* A collaborative, team-oriented environment with direct access to leadership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact within a growing organization
* Company-sponsored team events and outings that foster connection and celebrate team success

**Work Authorization**

Jensen Metal Products does not sponsor employment visas now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship.

**Recruiting Agencies**

Jensen Metal Products does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, recruiting firms, or search agencies. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Jensen Metal Products employees or through our application process will become the property of Jensen Metal Products, and no fee will be paid if the candidate is hired.

**About Loenbro**

Loenbro is a trusted, long-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical & Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care.

**At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose.** Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps expand the reach of the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation.

  

**Job Summary**

The Director of Quality - Fabrication & Manufacturing is responsible for developing, implementing, and leading the enterprise quality strategy across Loenbro's Fabrication & Manufacturing network. This position will establish a consistent, scalable quality management framework supporting mechanical and pipe fabrication, structural fabrication, electrical prefab, modular assembly, and future manufactured products across Loenbro facilities.

A primary initial responsibility will be conducting a comprehensive assessment of existing facility certifications, code qualifications, quality programs, procedures, personnel qualifications, inspection capabilities, and customer-specific requirements. The Director will use this assessment to establish a fleet-wide certification and quality strategy aligned with Loenbro's target markets, facility specialization, and long-term manufacturing strategy.

The Director will lead the transition from predominantly project-specific quality control toward a proactive manufacturing quality model centered on first-time quality, error prevention, standardized processes, measurable performance, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement. The role will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Project Management, Welding and Process Improvement, Safety, Estimating, Supply Chain, Business Development, project teams, and customers to ensure consistent quality delivery.

The Director will also develop quality plans and strategies supporting new products, manufacturing processes, facilities, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, and expansion into new end markets, while serving as a senior customer-facing quality leader capable of confidently articulating Loenbro's quality systems, capabilities, certifications, controls, and continuous-improvement philosophy.

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Quality Strategy & Governance**

* Develop and implement a standardized Fabrication & Manufacturing quality strategy across Loenbro's manufacturing network.
* Establish enterprise quality standards, policies, procedures, governance, and minimum requirements across mechanical, structural, electrical prefab, modular assembly, and manufactured-product operations.
* Transition the organization toward a prevention-based manufacturing quality model focused on building quality into the process rather than relying primarily on final inspection.
* Define quality roles, responsibilities, accountability, escalation processes, and standardized expectations across facilities and projects.
* Develop a scalable quality framework capable of supporting Loenbro's growth from project-based fabrication into repeatable manufacturing.

**Certification & Qualification Strategy**

* Conduct a comprehensive assessment and gap analysis of existing certifications, accreditations, code stamps, welding qualifications, procedures, inspection capabilities, personnel qualifications, and facility-specific quality programs.
* Develop and maintain a centralized certification and qualification matrix across all Fabrication & Manufacturing facilities.
* Establish a fleet-wide certification strategy defining which certifications and qualifications should be maintained, expanded, consolidated, or added at individual facilities.
* Align certification investments with facility specialization, customer requirements, target markets, and Loenbro's hub-and-spoke manufacturing strategy.
* Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable AWS, ASME, AISC, NEC/NFPA, UL, ISO, customer-specific, and other relevant requirements as applicable to Loenbro's work.
* Establish governance for welder qualifications, welding procedures, inspection personnel qualifications, calibration programs, and required quality records.
* Develop the quality-system roadmap required to support increasingly regulated and technically demanding markets, including future nuclear/NQA-1 capability where aligned with Loenbro's strategy.

**First-Time Quality & KPI Management**

* Develop and maintain a standardized Fabrication & Manufacturing quality scorecard focused on first-time quality, error prevention, trend visibility, and accountability.
* Track weld reject and repair rates, weld first-pass acceptance, NDE rejection rates, rework hours and cost, scrap, dimensional and fit-up nonconformances, drawing/fabrication errors, NCRs, corrective-action closure and recurrence, customer issues, supplier quality, punch-list deficiencies, electrical prefab defects, testing failures, first-pass yield, cost of poor quality, and quality-related schedule impacts.
* Establish leading indicators in addition to traditional lagging quality metrics.
* Create dashboards that provide leadership visibility into performance by facility, project, product, process, welder, supplier, and other relevant dimensions.
* Benchmark facilities and processes to identify best practices, systemic risks, and improvement opportunities.

**Mechanical, Welding & Structural Quality**

* Partner closely with Welding and Process Improvement leadership to establish consistent welding quality standards across the fabrication network.
* Monitor weld reject rates, repair rates, NDE performance, welder performance, WPS adherence, consumable controls, and recurring defect trends.
* Ensure appropriate welding procedures, qualifications, documentation, inspection requirements, material traceability, dimensional control, coatings, and testing requirements are maintained.
* Establish quality controls for structural fabrication, skids, racks, modular assemblies, equipment integration, and related manufactured products.
* Identify systemic fabrication and welding issues and implement corrective and preventive actions across affected facilities.

**Electrical Prefab Quality**

* Partner with Electrical Prefab leadership to establish appropriate quality controls for electrical assemblies and manufactured products.
* Develop standardized inspection, testing, documentation, traceability, and acceptance requirements appropriate to the type and complexity of electrical prefab being produced.
* Establish metrics addressing assembly errors, wiring and termination defects, dimensional issues, testing failures, labeling/documentation deficiencies, and field rework attributable to prefab.
* Support standardized work instructions, inspection points, testing protocols, and product acceptance criteria as electrical prefab evolves toward increasingly standardized and productized solutions.

**Quality Planning & New Product Introduction**

* Develop quality plans for major projects, new products, new manufacturing processes, and new end markets.
* Participate early in productization and design-development activities so quality requirements are incorporated into product and manufacturing-process design.
* Establish inspection and test plans, hold/witness points, acceptance criteria, documentation requirements, traceability, and turnover packages as appropriate.
* Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, manufacturing-readiness reviews, and new-product introduction processes.
* Identify potential failure modes before production and establish controls designed to prevent defects, using risk-based methods such as FMEA where appropriate.
* Establish first-article, prototype, pilot-production, and production-release processes for new standardized products.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish a consistent NCR, root-cause analysis, corrective-action, and preventive-action process across the manufacturing network.
* Ensure significant quality events are investigated to determine systemic causes rather than simply correcting individual defects.
* Track corrective actions through implementation and verify effectiveness to prevent recurrence.
* Identify recurring trends across facilities and deploy enterprise-level corrective actions where appropriate.
* Partner with Operations and Process Improvement to reduce variation, eliminate recurring defects, improve productivity, and lower the cost of poor quality.
* Establish mechanisms for sharing lessons learned and best practices across the network.

**Project, Customer & Commercial Quality**

* Partner with project teams early to understand project-specific quality requirements and translate them into executable shop quality plans.
* Ensure alignment among engineering requirements, procurement specifications, fabrication processes, inspection, testing, documentation, and turnover.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for significant Fabrication & Manufacturing quality matters.
* Participate in customer quality meetings, audits, facility assessments, pre-award qualifications, and strategic pursuits.
* Clearly and confidently articulate Loenbro's fabrication and manufacturing quality systems, certifications, capabilities, controls, and performance to customers.
* Support Business Development and Estimating with quality strategies and requirements for strategic pursuits and new end markets.

**Supplier Quality**

* Partner with Supply Chain to establish supplier and subcontractor quality requirements for critical materials, equipment, components, and outsourced fabrication.
* Develop risk-based supplier qualification, surveillance, inspection, performance-management, and corrective-action processes.
* Track supplier-related NCRs, defects, documentation issues, and other quality impacts and ensure requirements flow through purchase orders and subcontracts.

**Quality Systems, Documentation & Digitalization**

* Standardize quality documentation, inspection records, turnover packages, NCR processes, audit records, certification records, and records-retention requirements across facilities.
* Partner with Operations and IT to evaluate and implement digital quality-management capabilities supporting the F&M network.
* Develop reliable data collection and analytics that integrate quality information with manufacturing, ERP/MRP, project controls, and operational reporting systems.
* Ensure quality records and traceability requirements scale appropriately as Loenbro moves toward repeatable manufacturing.

**Facility Strategy, Acquisitions & Integration**

* Assess quality systems, certifications, personnel, procedures, and capabilities of potential acquisition targets.
* Identify certification gaps, compliance risks, required investments, and integration requirements during acquisition due diligence.
* Develop quality integration plans for acquired facilities and support facility specialization decisions.
* Participate in new facility planning to ensure appropriate quality infrastructure is incorporated from the beginning.

**Leadership & Organizational Development**

* Provide functional leadership to quality personnel supporting Fabrication & Manufacturing facilities and projects.
* Establish competency requirements, training standards, and development pathways for quality professionals.
* Build a culture where quality is owned by Operations and the workforce, with Quality serving as system owner, technical resource, verifier, and improvement partner.
* Promote transparency, accountability, stop-work authority, learning, standardized work, and proactive error prevention.

  

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Weld reject and repair rates, and weld first-pass acceptance.
* NDE rejection rates and inspection performance.
* Rework hours and cost, scrap, and cost of poor quality.
* Dimensional and fit-up nonconformances, and drawing/fabrication errors.
* NCR volume, corrective-action closure, and recurrence rates.
* Customer issues, punch-list deficiencies, and supplier quality performance.
* Electrical prefab defects and testing failures.
* First-pass yield and quality-related schedule impacts.

  

**Strategic Priorities**

* Baseline all existing F&M certifications, qualifications, procedures, and quality capabilities.
* Develop a fleet-wide certification and qualification roadmap aligned with target markets and facility specialization.
* Establish common quality standards and governance across the manufacturing network.
* Implement a standardized F&M quality scorecard and first-time-quality metrics.
* Reduce welding defects, rework, recurring NCRs, and overall cost of poor quality.
* Establish consistent corrective-action, lessons-learned, and error-prevention processes.
* Integrate quality planning into engineering, productization, estimating, and project execution earlier in the lifecycle.
* Develop scalable quality systems for standardized mechanical, electrical, structural, skid, modular, and integrated M&E products.
* Strengthen customer-facing quality capabilities to support external F&M growth.
* Establish the quality foundation necessary to pursue more sophisticated and regulated markets, including future NQA-1 nuclear capability.

  

**Key Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive quality leadership experience in fabrication, manufacturing, construction, EPC, industrial services, or related environments.
* Demonstrated experience developing and implementing quality-management systems across multiple facilities or operating locations strongly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of welding and fabrication quality systems, inspection, NDE, material control, traceability, and corrective-action processes.
* Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards such as AWS, ASME, AISC, ISO, and other relevant fabrication/manufacturing requirements.
* Experience supporting electrical manufacturing or prefab quality programs preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with root-cause analysis, corrective/preventive action, first-pass yield, cost of poor quality, and continuous improvement.
* Experience developing project-specific and product-specific quality plans and supporting customer audits and qualification activities.
* Experience with new-product introduction, acquisition due diligence, and integration preferred.
* Experience with nuclear quality systems or NQA-1 is highly desirable as Loenbro develops future nuclear manufacturing capabilities.
* Strong analytical and executive communication skills, with the ability to convert quality data into actionable operational improvements.
* Ability to travel regularly among Loenbro fabrication and manufacturing facilities and project locations.

  

**Leadership Competencies**

* **Enterprise Mindset** — Thinks beyond individual shops and establishes systems that improve performance across the entire manufacturing network.
* **Quality Leadership** — Builds a culture where quality is designed into the work and owned throughout the organization.
* **Technical Credibility** — Engages confidently with craft professionals, inspectors, engineers, project leaders, executives, and customers.
* **Prevention Focus** — Prioritizes error prevention and process control over inspection and correction after the fact.
* **Data-Driven Decision Making** — Uses meaningful KPIs and trend analysis to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* **Root-Cause Discipline** — Drives corrective actions that address systemic causes and prevent recurrence.
* **Customer Confidence** — Clearly articulates Loenbro's quality capabilities and strategy to sophisticated customers.
* **Continuous Improvement** — Develops scalable solutions that improve quality, productivity, and predictability.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership** — Collaborates effectively across Operations, Engineering, Welding, Project Management, Supply Chain, Estimating, Business Development, Safety, and project teams.
* **Builder Mentality** — Establishes systems, standards, processes, and organizational capabilities required for a growing manufacturing enterprise.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Construction Management, Manufacturing, Welding Engineering/Technology, or a related technical discipline preferred; equivalent significant relevant experience may be considered.

  

**Measures of Success**

Initial success will be demonstrated through completion of a comprehensive network-wide certification and quality-capability assessment; establishment of a clearly defined fleet certification strategy; implementation of standardized quality KPIs and first-time-quality reporting; measurable reduction in weld rejects, rework, recurring NCRs, and cost of poor quality; and implementation of consistent quality planning and corrective-action processes across Fabrication & Manufacturing.

Longer-term success will be measured by Loenbro's ability to deliver increasingly complex and repeatable fabricated and manufactured products with predictable first-time quality, maintain the certifications and quality systems required by targeted end markets, demonstrate continuous quality improvement across the manufacturing network, and establish a scalable quality platform supporting Loenbro's transformation from project-based fabrication into a differentiated manufacturing business.

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Environment:**

* Primarily based in a manufacturing/fabrication shop and office environment, with regular travel across Loenbro's Fabrication & Manufacturing facilities and project sites.
* Frequent visits to fabrication shops, manufacturing floors, and industrial job sites to assess quality programs, certifications, and inspection capabilities.
* Potential exposure to noise, dust, welding fumes, and other typical industrial and manufacturing environment factors while touring facilities.
* Regular engagement with customers, auditors, and facility personnel, which may require regional and national travel by air and ground transportation.

*This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH&S) policies.*

  

**Benefits**

Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan with company match
* Performance-based bonus plan
* Long-term Incentives
* Paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay
* Life and disability insurance
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

*Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.*

  

Guided by **Core Values (LEAD)**, grounded in **grit** and a **commitment to excellence**, Loenbro **betters** our families, customers, and **local** communities. If you're ready to be part of a company that **LEADS** by:

* **L****iving with Integrity**
* **E****xceeding Expectations**
* **A****cting with Urgency**
* **D****elivering Excellence**

…we want to hear from you.

**Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

existing_roles.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Company Overview
  
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
  
Position Brand Description
  
How would you like a career where you get to apply your best technical and analytical skills to bring complex, high-potency biologic medicines to patients? We are seeking a scientific leader on our Parenteral Product Network Technical Services/Manufacturing Science (TS/MS) team to drive the commercialization of lyophilized drug products, with a focus on antibody drug conjugates (ADCs), and to provide technical support for commercial lyophilized product manufacturing.
  
In this role, you are critical to the success of Lilly’s oncology and biologics portfolio. As a Global Product Steward and lyophilization process expert, you will hold technical ownership of assigned lyophilized ADC and other parenteral products from late-stage development through the commercial lifecycle, serving as the technical link between Product Development and our commercial manufacturing sites. You will ensure these products are successfully launched, reliably supplied, and technically well controlled across internal and external sites.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
As an individual contributor, you will work side by side with colleagues in Product Development, Manufacturing Operations, Quality, EHS, and Supply Chain, as well as with external manufacturing organizations. You will be a visible technical presence in cross-functional teams, mentor junior technical associates, and escalate significant technical, quality, safety, and supply risks to management with clear assessments and recommended actions.
  
  
**Key responsibilities include:**  

* Serve as Global Product Steward and subject matter expert for lyophilized, ADC and parenteral products, holding end-to-end technical accountability for process performance, product quality, and supply across all manufacturing sites, and serving as the primary technical interface between Product Development and commercial manufacturing.
* Advance lyophilization technology in commercial manufacturing
* Maintain the product technical knowledge base and lifecycle strategy, including process history, critical material and supplier knowledge, a product technical risk register, and a roadmap for yield, robustness, capacity, and site-network improvements.
* Collaborate with product development and manufacturing site for technology transfer, scale-up, process performance qualification/validation, and comparability activities (including lyophilization cycle transfer between freeze-dryers of differing scale and design) to support commercial launch readiness.
* Escalate significant technical, quality, safety, compliance, and supply risks to TS/MS management in a timely manner, providing risk assessments, impact to patients and supply, and recommended mitigation plans.
* Own the commercial control strategy for lyophilization critical process parameters and critical quality attributes, and maintain process understanding through continued process verification, stability and batch trending, and global product assessment.
* Partner with Product Development to ensure manufacturability of new ADC and lyophilized products, and to provide commercial manufacturing feedback that informs formulation, cycle design, specifications, container closure selection, and site selection.
* Author and review technical sections of global regulatory submissions, post-approval changes, and responses to regulatory questions, and support inspection readiness at commercial sites.
* Lead process improvement and lifecycle management projects, including introduction of new lyophilization, filling, and containment technologies and qualification of vials, stoppers, and other critical materials.

Basic Qualifications
  
  

* A degree in a relevant area such as Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, or Chemistry with one of the following:
* PhD degree with 5 years of practical experience in parenteral, biologic, or antibody drug conjugate drug substance or drug product development and/or manufacturing, or
* Master’s degree with 10 years of practical experience in parenteral, biologic, or antibody drug conjugate drug substance or drug product development and/or manufacturing, or
* Bachelor’s degree with 15 years of practical experience in parenteral, biologic, or antibody drug conjugate drug substance or drug product development and/or manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with lyophilization development or manufacturing (e.g., formulation and cycle development, scale-up, tech transfer, or commercial cycle support).
* Working knowledge of protein-based and ADC drug product formulation and aseptic fill/finish processes.
* Experience supporting GMP commercial manufacturing, including technology transfer, process validation, and/or deviation investigation and resolution.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Lilly does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B or TN status) for this employment position.
  
  
Additional Skills/Preferences
  
We want you to bring your lyophilization and biologics expertise, commercial manufacturing experience, and technical influence to help launch and supply ADC and other lyophilized medicines.
  
  
**Preferred experience includes:**  

* Direct ADC drug product experience, including handling of cytotoxic or highly potent payloads and the stability and process sensitivities of conjugated antibodies.
* Background in lyophilized product development, including formulation and excipient selection, freeze-drying cycle design, and thermal characterization, and cycle scale-up.
* Analytical characterization of lyophilized biologics and ADCs
* Experience with container closure and critical material qualification, including vial and stopper selection, container closure integrity, and the interaction of materials with processing equipment.
* Product stewardship experience, such as serving as technical owner or product lead for a commercial or late-stage product, authoring annual product reviews or technical risk assessments, and managing multi-site process harmonization.
* Demonstrated leadership, influence, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret complex technical data, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, and clearly escalate risks and recommendations to management.
* Preparation, review, and response to global regulatory submissions (e.g., BLAs, NDAs, or equivalent), post-approval changes, and support of regulatory inspections.
* Working knowledge of statistical design of experiments and analysis, and of containment strategies and occupational exposure limits for potent compounds.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Development, Operations, Quality, EHS, and external manufacturing partners.

We’re also excited if you bring an insatiable desire to learn, to innovate, and to challenge yourself for the benefit of patients.
  
  
Additional Information
  
  

* Recognition and future promotion on the Technical Ladder
* 10–20% domestic and international travel to commercial manufacturing sites and partners (to be confirmed by leadership)
* Lilly is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  
Lilly is proud to be an EEO Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  
  
Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Our current groups include: Africa, Middle East, Central Asia (AMECA), Black Employees at Lilly (BE@Lilly), Chinese Culture Network (CCN), EnAble, Evolve, Lilly Indian Network (LIN), Organization of Latinx at Lilly (OLA), Pride (LGBTQ+ Allies), Veterans Leadership Network (VLN) and Women’s Initiative for Leading at Lilly (WILL).
  
  
Actual compensation will depend on a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. The anticipated wage for this position is
  
$130,500 - $211,200
  
  
Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending, in part, on company and individual performance). In addition, Lilly offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees, including eligibility to participate in a company-sponsored 401(k); pension; vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities).Lilly reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion and Lilly’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Lilly employees.

existing_roles.description:
**Position Summary:**

**The Director of Contract Manufacturing** focuses activities and resources in the organization around value creation and has responsibility for the success of the value stream. Unlike Steffes’ product-line business units, Contract Manufacturing does not own a product line; it markets and sells Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services, building to customer designs, specifications, and requirements.

The Director of Contract Manufacturing understands key system constraints, quickly identifies critical process issues and successfully maintains key customer relationships. Has management responsibility for the strategy, relationship management, pricing and margin.

This role must have excellent business, manufacturing, and technical knowledge; as well as interpersonal skills to communicate and be an influencer, both internal and external to the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintains responsibility for assigned business unit, including profitability, business development and budgeting.

* Develops sales and promotional strategies for Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services within the Value Stream.

* Sets vision, defines direction, influences and inspires others, aligns and leads teams to create value and grow the business.

* Responsible for increasing and tracking contract manufacturing revenue and market share.

* Responsible for advancing key customer relationships.

* Works with other department leaders to aid in allocation of resources and capacity to achieve specific business results.

* Coaches and assists team members.

* Sets clear expectations for the customer program life cycle, from quote through production and delivery, and ensures the team understands goals and expectations.

* Identifies risks and establishes suitable actions.

* Responsible for overall customer experience and customer care.

* Maintains a deep understanding of Steffes’ engineering and production processes, capabilities, and capacity.

* Ensures accurate and timely technical reviews of customer designs, drawings, and requirements.

* Establishes pricing based on cost estimates and market value such that market share and profitability goals can be met.

* Maintains a good understanding of competing contract manufacturers and engineering service providers, including their capabilities, marketing strategies, and relative costs. Be capable of effectively communicating this information with the sales department and other functional areas.

* Works with account managers to develop strategies to sell Steffes’ engineering and manufacturing services to current and prospective customers.

* Ensures Steffes’ contract manufacturing services are competitive from the standpoint of quality, reliability, cost, lead time, and on-time shipping by calling out deficiencies and seeing proper action is initiated to correct problem areas.

* Monthly maintains financial forecasting and price reviews.

* Communicates with internal staff on a regular basis to understand their business problems and help find solutions.

* Maintains a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a collaborative manner with customers, suppliers, co-workers, and management.

* Helps company meet its Strategic, Quality, and Safety objectives.

* Assists with development and execution of annual sales plans.

* Establishes and maintains guidelines for pursuing and accepting new business.

* Daily monitors shipping activity, costing and pricing to ensure sales and profitability goals are being achieved.

* Assists CFO with review of Terms & Conditions and MSA’s and negotiates with the customer to resolve differences.

* Ensures prompt and satisfactory resolution to external quality issues on customer parts and assemblies.

* Other duties may be assigned

**Job Requirements/Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering or equivalent experience preferred.
* 5 years of experience working in engineering, manufacturing, marketing, or sales
* Experience selling or managing engineering and/or contract manufacturing services with customers.
* Intermediate computer knowledge (Windows, email, internet, etc.)
* Written and verbal communication skills
* Overnight travel is required occasionally

-OR-

* An acceptable combination of education and experience

**Functional & Cognitive Requirements of Position**

* This position requires walking, sitting or standing to a significant degree.
* Must have the ability to lift 50 pounds from floor to waist, carry 50 pounds, and push and/or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Must have the ability to climb ladders and/or stairs.
* Stooping, crouching, kneeling and bending.
* Handling, feeling, and gripping would be required for some activities.
* Visual acuity is required to inspect work completed.
* This role may be subject to internal and external environmental conditions.
* Learn new tasks, remember processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, make timely decisions in the context of a workflow, ability to communicate with visitors, ability to complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity quota.

**Core Values:**  
**Trust:** We promote growth and long-term success by making wise decisions with trust as an essential component.  
**Respect:** We unleash creative talents of our diverse workforce by treating each other the way we would like to be treated.  
**Teamwork**: We believe people achieve much more by working together.  
**Integrity:** We follow through and keep our word while being open, honest, ethical, and fair.  
**Safety:** We view our co-workers as family members of our business and strive to ensure safety for all. • Humility: We recognize and appreciate strengths and contributions beyond one’s self. We are modest, genuine, and authentic.  
  
**Core Expectations:**  
**Customer Service** - Demonstrate excellent customer service and display a positive attitude and behavior consistent with the Steffes Code of Conduct and Core Values.  
**Environmental, Health, Safety (EHS)** – Perform work in compliance with EHS training and identified procedures/standard work. Report any EHS incident or concern to your supervisor immediately. Cooperate and contribute to the overall success of the EHS program.  
**Quality** – Participate in job-specific training. Complete work as indicated by standard work, processes, and/or procedures. If your work can’t be completed as required, notify your supervisor immediately for guidance.  
**Conduct** - Demonstrate and support the Steffes Code of Conduct.  
**Policies and Procedures** - Demonstrate and support Steffes Policies and Procedures by:  
o Using tact, sound judgement, and maintaining a professional attitude in communication and relationships with others.  
o Striving to deliver the best quality in daily work.  
o Promoting a positive image of Steffes and its products.  
o Being timely and punctual in attendance and following all policies and procedures.

*Equal Opportunity Employer*

Equal Opportunity Employer

existing_roles.description:
**ADMA Biologics** is a biopharmaceutical company relentlessly committed to creating superior products for immunodeficient patients at risk for infection. It is our devotion to this underserved population that fuels us and our hands-on approach to production and development that sets us apart. If you are looking for a dynamic, innovative, growing company in the biopharmaceutical industry that is committed to excellence and integrity, then consider ADMA Biologics. We currently have an exciting opportunity available for a **Senior Director, Quality Assurance in Boca Raton, FL!**

Job Title: Senior Director, Quality Assurance

Job Description:

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Senior Director, Quality Assurance, is responsible for leading and executing the QA strategy for strong oversight of the end-to-end production for ADMA Biologics’ specialty plasma-derived products. This leader will ensure that materials, processes, facilities, and products meet applicable regulatory requirements and ADMA’s strict quality standards. The role requires sound GMP judgment, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to resolve complex quality issues while supporting reliable product supply.

**Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**
---------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop the QA teams responsible for manufacturing oversight, batch record review, product disposition, and quality systems execution.
* Provide operational leadership and expertise in the development, implementation, and training of cGMP compliant quality systems, such as document control, change control, investigations, deviations, CAPA, and product quality complaints.
* Provide independent quality oversight of plasma manufacturing operations, aseptic filling, packaging, and associated laboratory and support activities, as applicable.
* Responsible for ensuring organizational goals are transmitted and communicated effectively throughout the QA department to include all members of the team.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE JOB**  
  
As the Director of Manufacturing Engineering, your role encompasses the strategic oversight and tactical management of manufacturing engineering and systems to support both the development of new products and the scaling of high-volume production in Waltham, MA. You are charged with ensuring rigorous manufacturing processes are in place, resulting in the consistent delivery of superior quality products to our customers. Your leadership will also guarantee the fulfillment of manufacturing's capacity commitments while driving advancements in digital tools and methodologies to improve design, analysis, and execution. This role demands an innovative and adaptable approach to solving complex manufacturing challenges in a highly dynamic environment.  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

* **Build & Lead the Manufacturing Engineering Team:** Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of manufacturing engineers and technical staff. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
* **Drive Manufacturing Strategy & Technology:** Develop and implement a long-term manufacturing engineering strategy aligned with Anduril Imaging's growth objectives. Drive adoption of automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, and digital manufacturing tools to enhance efficiency and scalability across development and high-volume production.
* **Lead New Product Introduction (NPI):** Partner with R&D and product development teams to ensure seamless transition of new products from design to production. Champion Design for Manufacturability (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles early in the development cycle to de-risk production scaling.
* **Scale Production Capability:** Evaluate, plan, and prioritize supply chain, production, and test optimizations to ensure the value stream can reliably meet production output goals. Develop business cases for vertical integration or supplier diversification where strategic partnerships will accelerate scalability.
* **Drive Continuous Improvement & Complexity Reduction:** Lead initiatives to improve yield, reduce cycle time, and lower cost across the manufacturing value chain. Drive commonality optimization, component and supplier rationalization, and process standardization to simplify production at scale.
* **Resource & Budget Management:** Manage budgets, staffing, and capital equipment planning for the manufacturing engineering organization. Forecast headcount and operational needs to support rapid scaling, including classified production environments.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role managing manufacturing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience owning manufacturing value chains for complex electro-mechanical or imaging hardware — defense, aerospace, or adjacent industries strongly preferred.
* Strong background in make-vs-buy analysis, contract manufacturer management, and supplier development for precision hardware.
* Experience managing NPI and scaling production in high-growth environments with condensed timelines.
* Familiarity with optical system integration and test, precision assembly, or imaging hardware manufacturing.
* Knowledge of automation, advanced manufacturing technologies, and digital manufacturing tools.
* Familiarity with quality systems (ISO 9001/AS9100) and PLM, MES, and ERP systems.
* Hands-on experience physically manufacturing hardware (assembly, soldering, machining, fabrication, etc.).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency.
