Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We’re looking for a Director, Quality to lead quality strategy and execution across Oura’s global engineering organization and supply chain.

### **What You Will Do:**

* In this role, you will ensure that quality and reliability are designed into our products, components, suppliers, and manufacturing processes from concept through development, launch, ramp, and sustaining operations. You will lead a global team of quality professionals and partner closely with Product Development, Hardware, Software, Reliability, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, and external suppliers.
* You will connect customer and field needs to engineering requirements, component controls, supplier capability, manufacturing performance, and product reliability. Your team will help Oura identify risks early, make evidence-based decisions, prevent defects, and resolve complex issues with durable corrective actions.
* This is a broad, highly cross-functional leadership role for an experienced quality executive who can set strategy, develop talent, influence engineering and operations leaders, and engage deeply in both product and supply chain quality when needed.
* Set the quality strategy: Define Oura’s quality vision, operating model, standards, metrics, and priorities across product development, components, suppliers, manufacturing, reliability, and the field.
* Lead and develop a global quality organization: Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing team across product quality, component quality, supplier quality, manufacturing quality, reliability, program quality, and sustaining quality.
* Embed quality across the product lifecycle: Establish effective quality gates and decision criteria from concept and architecture through EVT, DVT, PVT, launch, ramp, and sustaining.
* Partner with engineering and product leaders: Influence product architecture, design decisions, materials, specifications, interfaces, validation plans, and manufacturability to prevent quality and reliability issues.
* Strengthen component and supplier quality: Translate product requirements into component specifications, supplier quality requirements, qualification plans, control plans, inspection strategies, and process controls. Drive supplier capability and performance across the global supply chain.
* Drive manufacturing readiness and performance: Ensure production processes are validated and controlled, with appropriate PFMEA, process capability, measurement systems, yield targets, traceability, reaction plans, and continuous improvement mechanisms.
* Lead risk-based quality planning: Establish disciplined use of DFMEA, PFMEA, reliability planning, design reviews, tolerance analysis, GR&R, SPC, DOE, and risk-based verification and validation.
* Own complex problem solving: Lead containment, failure analysis, root-cause investigation, corrective action, preventive action, and verification of effectiveness for product, component, supplier, manufacturing, reliability, and field issues.
* Build strong field-quality feedback loops: Use warranty, returns, customer support, field failure, reliability, manufacturing, and supplier data to identify systemic risks and drive improvements that reduce member impact and cost of poor quality.
* Lead launch and ramp readiness: Review product and component qualification, supplier capability, manufacturing readiness, validation evidence, yield, open risks, reliability results, and corrective actions before launch and ramp decisions.
* Govern quality-related changes: Ensure design, material, component, supplier, process, software, and manufacturing changes are evaluated for quality and reliability impact and implemented consistently through ECR/ECN and change-control processes.
* Establish a data-driven quality operating system: Define leading and lagging indicators across development, suppliers, manufacturing, and the field. Improve data quality, traceability, dashboards, and escalation mechanisms.
* Drive continuous improvement: Reduce defects, escapes, returns, warranty claims, rework, scrap, and other sources of cost of poor quality while improving product reliability, supplier performance, and customer experience.
* Influence cross-functional decisions: Provide clear, risk-based recommendations when quality, schedule, cost, performance, capacity, and supply continuity priorities compete.
* Communicate with senior leadership: Present concise assessments of product risk, supplier and manufacturing performance, launch readiness, field quality, and improvement priorities.
* Build a culture of prevention and accountability: Make quality a shared responsibility across engineering and operations, with clear ownership for requirements, validation, supplier controls, manufacturing execution, and sustained performance.

This is a hybrid role out of our San Francisco office.

### **What you'll bring**

* 15+ years of experience in product quality, supplier quality, manufacturing quality, reliability, operations quality, or a related engineering discipline, including significant people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading quality for complex, high-volume consumer electronics, wearable, medical-adjacent, or similarly reliability-sensitive products.
* Experience leading and developing teams across one or more of the following areas: product quality, component quality, supplier quality, manufacturing quality, reliability, program quality, or sustaining quality.
* A track record of establishing quality strategy, operating mechanisms, and measurable improvements from early product development through launch and sustaining.
* Strong understanding of product development, design verification and validation, component qualification, reliability engineering, supplier quality, manufacturing processes, and production ramp.
* Strong command of quality and problem-solving methods, including FMEA, 8D, CAPA, SPC, GR&R, DOE, root-cause analysis, control plans, and process capability.
* Experience using engineering, field, warranty, customer support, supplier, and manufacturing data to identify systemic risks and drive corrective action.
* Demonstrated ability to influence engineering, operations, suppliers, and executive leadership without relying solely on direct authority.
* Experience with engineering change control, supplier changes, component qualification, process validation, manufacturing readiness, or production quality improvement.
* Strong understanding of DFM/DFA, GD&T, Lean and Six Sigma principles, measurement systems, and quality management systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical risks into concise decisions and actions.
* A self-directed, pragmatic, and resilient leadership style, with a willingness to engage deeply in details while maintaining a strategic perspective.
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Systems, Manufacturing, or a related engineering field required; advanced degree or quality certification is a plus.
* Preferred qualifications
* Experience with both product quality and supplier or manufacturing quality, or demonstrated ability to operate effectively across both domains.
* Experience with batteries, electronics, sensors, RF systems, precision mechanics, adhesives, miniaturized assemblies, or other demanding product technologies.
* Experience leading quality for products that combine hardware, firmware, software, and cloud-enabled member experiences.
* Experience building or scaling quality management systems during rapid company growth.
* Familiarity with product safety, regulatory, compliance, traceability, and risk-management requirements relevant to wearable technology.
* Experience with supplier development, APQP, PPAP, SCAR processes, multi-source strategies, capacity expansion, or major manufacturing transitions.
* Experience working across multiple countries, engineering sites, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

### **Nice to have:**

* HW Experience
* Global distributor teams
* grown and org

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, direction, and operational performance of an automotive manufacturing facility. The Plant Manager provides strategic leadership to all plant functions—including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Engineering, Materials, HR, and EHS—ensuring alignment with organizational goals and customer requirements. This position plays a critical role in developing a high-performing culture, optimizing manufacturing processes, growing talent, and ensuring the long-term success and competitiveness of the facility.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for plant operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production across robotic assembly, and related processes.
* Establish and execute plant strategies focused on safety performance, customer satisfaction, financial targets, operational efficiency, and workforce development.
* Lead, mentor, and develop department managers, supervisors, and cross-functional teams to drive a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* Ensure compliance with safety policies, regulatory requirements, and environmental standards while actively promoting a world-class safety culture.
* Oversee adherence to IATF 16949, ISO, customer-specific requirements, and internal quality standards; partner with Quality to address issues and implement corrective actions.
* Monitor and manage plant KPIs including OEE, scrap, uptime, throughput, labor efficiency, and cost performance; ensure action plans are in place to address underperformance.
* Partner with Maintenance and Engineering to ensure equipment reliability, effective PM programs, and timely response to downtime or tooling issues.
* Oversee Materials/Logistics operations including inventory accuracy, material flow, scheduling, shipping, and customer delivery performance.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives, waste elimination efforts, standardized work implementation, and continuous improvement projects throughout the facility.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and visual factory standards across all production areas.
* Develop and manage annual plant budgets, capital expenditures, and long-term investment strategies.
* Collaborate with corporate leadership on production planning, capacity analysis, new program launches, engineering changes, and customer development initiatives.
* Ensure organizational compliance with HR, labor, ethics, and employment practices, including respect for human rights, non-discriminatory treatment, proper working hours, and wage law compliance.
* Build a positive employee relations environment through strong communication, coaching, and recognition; address workforce concerns and support effective engagement strategies.
* Lead regular plant meetings to ensure alignment, transparency, and effective communication across all levels of the organization.
* Represent the facility with customers, suppliers, auditors, and corporate partners.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all environmental practices are in line with job scope / position. Examples include but not limited to: proper waste disposal practices, reporting of spills, non-compliance to permit, and addressing any improper practices.
* Employee is responsible for ensuring all human resources, ethics, and labor policies and practices are carried out in accordance with company policy and as in line with the scope of the position. Examples include but are not limited to: respecting the human rights of all workers (prohibition of forced labor, no child labor, maintaining appropriate working hours, and non-discriminatory treatment of all workers), abiding by ethical standards such as zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, extortion, and embezzlement, maintaining appropriate working hours of employees along with ensuring compensation is paid to workers that complies with all applicable wage laws.
* Assumes additional duties as assigned, which may fall outside the primary scope of the role.

**ISO / ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT SYSTEM (EMS) RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure that the resources needed for the environmental management system are available.
* Communicate the importance of effective environmental management and of conforming to the environmental management system requirements.
* Ensure that the environmental management system achieves its intended outcomes.
* Direct and support persons to contribute to the effectiveness of the environmental management system.

Requirements:

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, Industrial Technology, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* 10–15 years of progressive manufacturing experience with at least 5 years in a leadership role; automotive robotic assembly experience strongly preferred.
* Proven track record of managing large teams, complex manufacturing operations, and high-volume production environments.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of automotive quality systems, including IATF 16949 and ISO standards.
* Demonstrated success improving plant performance, reducing costs, and driving operational excellence.

**GENERAL SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong leadership presence with the ability to inspire, influence, and motivate teams.
* Excellent communication skills for interacting with employees at all levels, customers, and executive leadership.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism.
* Ability to build a culture of trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**SOFTWARE/COMPUTER SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with ERP or MES systems such as SAP, Oracle, Plex, QAD, or similar manufacturing platforms.
* Ability to interpret data dashboards, KPIs, and operational reports to guide decision-making.
* Demonstrated proficiency with digital tools used for production reporting, labor tracking, and quality management.

Apnimed is committed to innovation, as well as state-of-the-art advancements in sleep medicine, which is leading to the development of a portfolio of novel pharmacologic therapies for sleep apnea and related disorders.

Recognized by the Boston Business Journal as one of the Best Places to Work in both 2024 and 2025, we are continuing to grow and build the foundational operations that enable our employees and our mission to thrive.

The Senior Manager, Quality Systems & Compliance reports to the Senior Director, GCP Quality Assurance and Quality Compliance and is responsible for administering, maintaining, and continuously improving Apnimed's electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) and associated quality processes, and for keeping them inspection-ready. The successful candidate will also play a key role in strengthening the Quality Management System infrastructure as a business partner across GxP and corporate quality functions, ensuring quality processes remain compliant, scalable, and aligned with the company's transition toward commercialization. This is an exciting opportunity to strengthen the quality infrastructure that supports Apnimed as part of a major paradigm shift in the treatment of sleep apnea from medical devices and surgery to a first in class pharmaceutical treatment.

existing_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering
existing_roles.description:
Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler (MC) is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **About The Role:**

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Platform Manufacturing Engineering to lead Production Manufacturing Engineering as we scale the Matter Compiler from pilot production into high-volume manufacturing. You will own the equipment that builds our devices — its build, integration, bring-up, qualification and reliability — and the team of engineers who deliver it.

**You are an engineer first.** This is a player-coach role and the player half is not decorative: you will spearhead the hardest projects on the critical path personally, in CAD and on the floor, and use that work as the vehicle for coaching everyone around you. The fastest way to set a standard here is to define it while you produce work that meets it, then mentor your team to achieve the same bar.

Mentoring here happens inside the work, not alongside it. You will pull engineers onto the projects you lead, hand off scope as they are ready for it, review their designs with real technical depth, and grow the next set of project leads out of people who learned by building with you.

The management half is real. You will hire against a plan rather than a wish list, develop engineers toward the next level, run performance honestly, and install the operating standards this function works to — documentation, change control, qualification and release discipline, and what "done" means before work leaves the group. You will plan the organization ahead of where the business is today, own headcount and capital budget, and get manufacturability and equipment requirements into specifications set by other teams rather than reviewing them at the end.

### **What You'll Do:**

* Spearhead the hardest equipment projects on the critical path yourself — architecture, CAD, build, bring-up and qualification — and bring engineers along on them as the primary way they develop.
* Lead a team of 5–10 engineers spanning equipment design, automation and controls, integration, and sustaining, through a mix of direct reports and technical leads.
* Set the engineering standard by producing work to it: reference designs, qualification plans, RCCAs and documentation your team can pattern from, with the reasoning made explicit so it transfers.
* Coach through the work — pair on designs, run technical reviews with real depth, hand off scope as engineers are ready for it, and grow the next set of project leads out of people who built alongside you.
* Own the delivery record for the function — the equipment, qualifications and production readiness your team commits to, against committed dates.
* Lead equipment deployment end to end: installation, validation, commissioning, acceptance testing, SOP/WI release and operator qualification.
* Run root cause and corrective action personally on the failures that matter, teach the method by doing it in front of the team, and drive the corrective actions across teams that do not report to you.
* Install and uphold the operating standards: documentation, change control, qualification and release discipline, RCCA method and closure, and how work is reviewed before it leaves the group.
* Plan organizational growth — forecast hiring needs ahead of demand, define roles and levels, build and defend the hiring plan, and manage headcount and capital budget with Supply Chain and Finance.
* Own and resolve escalated personnel situations arising from business and priority changes, rather than routing them away.
* Get manufacturability and equipment requirements into specification setting and design milestones with Design Engineering and Product, rather than reviewing at the end.
* Balance competing priorities with peer leaders so committed deliverables are still met, and own communication of impact and resolution path where they cannot be.
* Own contract manufacturer and automation supplier execution through final integration and test to conformant hardware on schedule.
* Drive throughput, yield, cost and uptime improvement — held with control limits, not delivered as one-time gains — and establish the operating metrics and reporting cadence leadership can rely on without chasing.
* Travel between Emeryville and Santa Clara sites as needed.

### **What You'll Need:**

* 7+ years of manufacturing or equipment engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers with 5 or more direct reports.
* **Current hands-on capability.** You still design in CAD, still debug hardware on the floor, and could take the hardest open task on your team's board tomorrow. We will test this directly in the loop.
* Proven ownership of automated production equipment end to end — architecture through mechanical, controls and software integration, into a qualified, released system running in production.
* Proficiency in CAD for equipment design (SolidWorks, Onshape, AutoCAD or similar), with recent personal use.
* A track record of **developing engineers through the work** — specific people who grew because you put them on projects you were leading, reviewed their designs, and handed off scope as they were ready for it.
* A track record of building out a functional group: defining roles, hiring against a plan, and installing the operating standards — not only inheriting an existing team.
* Experience leading a team spanning more than one discipline (e.g., equipment, controls/automation, integration, sustaining), including people whose work sits outside your own background.
* Ownership of headcount and capital budget, with resourcing tradeoff decisions made under real constraint.
* Depth across DFx, RCCA, eBOMmBOM conversion, qualification and acceptance testing, and PLM/document control and release (Arena a plus).
* Experience in semiconductor, solar, hardware-based biotech, EV, or similar high-tech industries.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functionally without authority — specifically, getting manufacturing and equipment requirements into specifications owned by other teams.
* A first-principles mindset — you question assumptions, reframe problems from the ground up, and approach challenges with a foundational understanding rather than relying solely on precedent.
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

### **Bonus Points For:**

* Experience standing up or rebuilding a manufacturing or equipment engineering function at a company moving from pilot to production scale.
* Experience staying technically current while managing — a design, patent, or build you personally delivered while running a team.
* Knowledge of basic coding: RSLogix, Ignition, Python, or C/C++.

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

**The Opportunity:**

Playing a critical role as the subject matter expert (SME) on stability management, the position will be responsible for management of outsourced stability studies. The Sr. Manager, stability is a self-motivated individual who works as a member of an integrated team from design, management, and evaluation stability studies outsourced to contract organization. This individual should have the breadth of experience and knowledge required to support commercial, late and early clinical development stage. This individual should have good understanding of ICH and cGMP guidelines and the ability to contribute to global regulatory filings for stability.

* Coordinate stability activities, including but not limited to monitor schedule, data entry, review and presentations/reports.
* Track stability studies, maintain stability database.
* Author and / or review stability related documents, including protocol, report, and memos.
* Work cross functionally with CMC, quality, regulatory, clinical and related teams to achieve stability objectives.
* Compile stability study results, perform trend and statistical analyses, and prepare reports to support retest/shelf-life date extensions and storage condition recommendations.
* Partner with quality during stability quality events (QEs) or investigations and implementation of CAPAs at contract organization.
* Manage sample shipment, inventory tracking, and chain of custody for stability studies.
* Support, author CMC stability documentation for IND, NDA, AR and IMPD filings, covering all phases of clinical development and commercial activities by ensure completeness and accuracy of stability data.

**Required Skills, Experience and Education:**

* PhD in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related discipline with 8+ years of industry experience; or MS with 10+ years, or BS with 12+ years.
* 6+ years in stability management or relevant experience within pharmaceutical or biotech industry.
* Strong knowledge of GMP regulations, quality systems, ICH guidelines, and regulatory expectations (FDA, EMA, etc.)
* Extensive experience managing contract organization and working in a virtual development model.
* Excellent leadership, people/team management, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving skills with strategic and technically sound decision-making ability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills.
* Energetic, team-oriented, and adaptable to a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with small molecule oncology drug development.

Develop a Culture of Quality

existing_roles.description:
**About Site**
--------------

Catalent’s Greendale, Indiana site is a key part of the company’s Wellness business, serving as one of North America’s primary gummy development and manufacturing centers. The site specializes in the formulation and production of traditional gelatin gummies and 100% plant‑based pectin gummies for nutritional supplements and nutraceutical applications, supporting a wide range of consumer health products. With strong in‑house R&D, quality laboratories, and flexible manufacturing and packaging capabilities, the Greendale operation partners closely with customers to develop innovative, high‑quality, and consumer‑friendly gummy delivery formats across a variety of flavors, shapes, and functional ingredients, all produced under rigorous quality and food‑safety standards.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We have an opportunity for a Senior Manager, Quality Systems to join our team and lead the Quality and Compliance functions at the Catalent Greendale site. This role oversees a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and release. The position ensures compliance with industry standards and regulations while driving continuous improvement across the Quality organization. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to maintain product integrity and ensure the consistent delivery of high‑quality products to our customers.

Shift: Monday through Friday, 8:00AM - 5:00PM  
Location: Greendale, IN  
100% Onsite

**The Role**
------------

* Oversee Quality and Compliance functions related to dietary supplement manufacturing at the Catalent Greendale site.
* Lead a team of Quality Assurance Supervisors and Specialists responsible for operational quality, product sampling, testing, and product release.
* Review and approve manufacturing and packaging change controls, product formulations, label changes, deviations, corrective and preventive action plans, and customer complaints.
* Ensure compliance with FDA, NSF, and SQF requirements for product manufacturing and participate in internal and external audits.
* Develop and maintain quality and compliance policies, procedures, and guidelines.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to product quality and oversee root cause analyses and corrective actions.
* Lead the Food Safety Team and ensure compliance with 21 CFR 110 and 117, HACCP Food Safety, and Food Defense Plans.
* Monitor the sanitary state of the facility and equipment to ensure cross‑contamination control.
* Collaborate with Operations to assess the effectiveness of sanitation programs and ensure compliance with food safety guidelines.
* Maintain a feedback loop with Customer Service to address quality issues affecting product release.
* Oversee training programs to educate staff on quality standards and compliance requirements.
* Establish and track key performance indicators to measure quality and compliance performance.
* Collaborate with Product Development, Technical Operations, and Supply Chain teams to integrate quality into all production processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Communicate effectively with regulatory agencies, external auditors, and internal stakeholders on quality and compliance matters.
* Oversee investigations, environmental monitoring, and critical control point incidents impacting product release.
* Support site management in enforcing current Good Manufacturing Practices and mentoring staff in compliance.
* Facilitate internal assessments, compliance meetings, and training sessions.

**The Candidate**
-----------------

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in science or related field (Chemistry, Microbiology, or Biology) and at least five years of pharmaceutical and dietary supplement quality experience.
* Minimum of seven years of related experience, including three to four years in a supervisory or management role.
* Experience in current Good Manufacturing Practice compliance and working in a quality role within the pharmaceutical or dietary supplement manufacturing industry.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure to meet deadlines. The individual may be required to sit, stand, walk regularly, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds; no lifting greater than 44.09 pounds without assistance. Must be accessible to the manufacturing floor and office staff and use required office equipment. Specific vision requirements include reading written documents and frequent use of a computer monitor.
* Demonstrable leadership experience at Catalent (including but not limited to participation in Catalent‑sponsored leadership programs such as NGGL, GOLD, LEAD Now, GM Excellence, and GROW) may be considered in place of external experience.

### **Preferred Skills & Background**

* Experience with investigation writing, including root cause analysis and report preparation for annual product reviews.
* Familiarity with regulations 21 CFR 111, 21 CFR 117, 21 CFR 211, GFSI, HACCP, Preventive Controls Qualified Individual, SQF, NSF, and UL certifications.
* Experience with electronic systems such as JDE, TrackWise, Electronic Document Management System, Learning Management System, Quality Management System, Veeva, Compliance Wire, and Stability Programs.
* Experience communicating with FDA inspectors or other regulatory agents and handling FDA 483 responses.
* Experience using artificial intelligence tools to improve quality systems.

**Why You Should Join Catalent**
--------------------------------

* Positive and fast‑paced working environment focusing on continually improving processes to remain innovative and dynamic.
* Competitive Paid Time Off plus eight paid holidays.
* Medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day one of employment.
* Tuition Reimbursement – support to complete or earn a new degree.
* Site‑based Employee Engagement activities such as End‑of‑Summer and NFL kickoff celebrations, March Madness tournament, Summer Food Truck Fridays, Veterans Appreciation Lunch, Homemade Chili Cook‑off, Salsa Competition, Ice Cream Sundae Bar, and more.
* Employee Resource Groups focusing on Diversity and Inclusion.
* Environmentally friendly, community engagement green initiatives.
* Defined career path and annual performance review process with potential for career growth on an expanding team.
* WellHub program promoting overall physical and mental wellness.
* Perkspot offering exclusive discounts from over 900 merchants across various categories.

**Catalent offers rewarding opportunities to further your career!** Join the global drug development and delivery leader and help us bring over 7,000 life-saving and life-enhancing products to patients around the world. Catalent is an exciting and growing international company where employees work directly with pharma, biopharma and consumer health companies of all sizes to advance new medicines from early development to clinical trials and to the market. Catalent produces more than 70 billion doses per year, and each one will be used by someone who is counting on us. Join us in making a difference.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**
============

Lead the development and deployment of quality processes and communications with the assigned region; drive quality culture, competent decision-making, appropriate risk assessments, and timely remediation of situations. Maintain frequent and open communications with executive and corporate leaders that focus on timely resolution of issues that may potentially affect the safety, quality, identity, purity, and/or potency of collected plasma. Review and monitor Quality metrics and reports for trends and opportunities for improvement.

  

**Reports To**: Sr. Director, Quality Assurance
  
**Direct Reports:** Assistant Manager of Quality (Approximately 6-7)

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

  
  

* Manage staff, including selecting, training, developing, coaching and terminating, as applicable with guidance from Human Resources. Appraise employee performance and provide feedback and counseling to staff, as applicable.
* Manage compliance to and successful use of the Quality System tools such as change and deviations management.
    
  Ensure regular management review of quality performance that delivers stable, high levels of compliance performance in assigned QA areas. Provide leadership and coordination to established automated systems for control.
* Manage Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) performance to ensure meeting regulatory and departmental requirements, and to drive continual improvement in department processes. Works with CSL applicable systems to analyze and identify significant quality issues/trends and reports those to appropriate Sr. Management. Provides routine reports on the quality KPIs as requested by the applicable business units.
* Maintain understanding of all policies and procedures. Participate in and may lead the development of functional policies and SOPs for assigned areas
* Establish, implement and ensure timely delivery of strategic Quality Assurance performance. Provide direction and guidance on quality topics including resolutions and corrective actions. Perform LSW above center visits. Ensure deployment and sustainability of in-center LSW practices to assigned region.
* Develop & maintain process to disseminate quality interpretation & strategies to operationalize relevant regulations, guidance & standards in collaboration with stakeholders. Maintain & update Quality training materials and provide consistent technical guidance to the operations team. Develop, deploy and occasionally deliver Quality information/publications to appropriate Corporate or Center staff.
* Mentor others on data analysis, technical problem prevention and resolution, design control procedures, investigation processes, and methods to arrive at true root causes as it relates to quality systems.
* Maintain high level of regulatory, compliance and communications skills with department staff, ensuring competence to make decisions and judgments in the course of business, including times of uncertainty.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, to support business needs.
  

  

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Business Administration or Quality Management required; or
* Minimum 8 years equivalent combination of education, training and experience
* Fluency in English/Spanish

**Experience**

* 5+ years’ experience successfully serving in a leadership role within an FDA-regulated or other regulated industry required
* Minimum 2 years managing people preferred
* Experience in leading projects to a successful conclusion
* Understand regulatory standards, various local, state, and federal laws that apply to the business and where to find information on standards and interpretations
* Computer literate with knowledge of word processing and spreadsheets
* Excellent critical reasoning, decision-making, and problem-solving skills to analyze situations, determine risks, find solutions to prevent future issues, and resolve recurring defects
* Strong leadership, training, written and verbal communication, and interpersonal and presentation skills to drive results
* Organizational skills and ability to manage projects involving multiple tasks by a team with deadlines.
* Good leadership and people management skills are essential in the success of leading project teams.
* Establish solid working relationships with to interface with and support senior management, third parties and other positions and circumstances within the organization
* Excellent customer service orientation with flexibility and adaptability to work as a member of the team and respond quickly to changes as required by the business operations
* Maintain a professional demeanor and handle confidential information with discretion
Lead teams without the benefit of a direct reporting relationship  

**Additional Comments**

The person selected for this position **will need to live/relocate to Puerto Rico**; they will be responsible for above-center quality leadership of all centers on the island.

**Working Conditions (physical & mental requirements)**

* Ability to make decisions which have significant impact on the department’s credibility, operations and services
* Ability to formulate complex and comprehensive materials such as authoritative reports of major scope and impact, etc. and/or to make formal presentations
* Exercise good judgment to refer decisions to management when decisions fall out of the realm of established guidelines

* Ability to lift or carry up to 25 lbs.
Fast-paced environment with frequent interruptions

**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

As Senior Vice President, Quality Engineering Manager for Payments Technology, you will own the test strategy for CitiDirect, Citi's award winning digital banking platform that gives clients one-click access to global transaction capabilities across payments, liquidity and trade. You will direct multiple testing teams, set the standards for test automation and User Acceptance Testing, and make sure every release of CitiDirect and its connected systems meets a high quality bar before reaching production. This is an opportunity to shape how a global bank validates mission critical payments technology and to build a modern, automated testing organization.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the test strategy for CitiDirect and its upstream and downstream applications across the Payments, Liquidity and Trade domains.

* Direct multiple testing teams, setting priorities and resolving complex issues that carry significant business impact.

* Design and implement User Acceptance Testing scripts and plans together with technology project managers, UAT professionals and business users.

* Build testing standards and quality benchmarks that keep automation, documentation and release processes consistent across teams.

* Plan and coordinate cross-team testing dependencies to keep releases on schedule and reduce production risk.

* Partner with development teams, IT project managers, business stakeholders and external vendors to align testing approach with delivery goals.

* Manage team performance and development, including hiring, coaching, compensation decisions and career planning for testing professionals.

* Assess risk in every release decision and escalate control issues early to protect Citi and its clients.

existing_roles.description:
**Job Title:**

Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering (Burnet, TX)

**Job Description:**

**THE ROLE**

The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality Engineering is responsible for leading manufacturing quality across two Entegris manufacturing sites in Texas and translating global quality standards and quality priorities into consistent site execution. This role provides multi-site leadership to reduce risk, strengthen process capability, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver measurable quality improvements across the two-site footprint.  
  
The Senior Manager partners with site Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, Customer Quality, Product Quality and Quality Systems teams to embed quality ownership into daily operations. This leader is accountable for site quality performance, consistent implementation of quality standards, compliance with applicable regulatory, industry, and customer requirements, and the development of capable site quality teams. The role leads through site quality leaders and teams, establishes clear ownership and follow-through, and escalates risks and resource needs to North America quality leadership.

The hired individual will work on-site at our Burnet, TX location with some travel to our Decatur, TX location.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Translate global quality standards and quality priorities into coordinated execution plans for the two Texas sites, with clear owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead manufacturing quality across all two sites through site quality leaders and teams; clarify responsibilities, prioritize resources based on risk, and maintain regular on-site engagement.
* Ensure consistent implementation of global quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices; maintain audit readiness and timely closure of findings at each site.
* Partner with site Operations leaders to establish quality roadmaps, objectives, and common key performance indicators (KPIs); conduct routine cross-site reviews and drive recovery plans where performance falls short.
* Own quality improvement plans that reduce defects, scrap, rework, cost of poor quality (COPQ), customer complaints, and manufacturing escapes, with site-level accountability for results.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve process capability, product conformity, yield, and manufacturing performance through effective process controls and proactive risk management.
* Lead targeted continuous improvement and change implementation across the two sites; standardize effective practices and verify that improvements are sustained.
* Ensure timely containment, disciplined root cause analysis, corrective/preventive action, and effectiveness verification for significant quality issues; deploy lessons learned across all two sites.
* Ensure practical, sustained application of SPC, MSA, FMEA, control plans, APQP, PPAP, 8D, A3, and DMAIC methodologies, as applicable to site processes and customer requirements.
* Serve as the quality escalation leader for the two Texas sites; communicate risk, containment status, recovery plans, and decisions needed, and escalate significant issues to Quality leadership.
* Partner with Customer Quality and Product Quality teams to resolve customer issues through timely, evidence-based investigations, effective corrective actions, and proactive communication.
* Develop site quality leaders and teams through coaching, clear expectations, technical capability building, and succession planning; identify staffing and resource needs across the two sites.
* Foster shared quality ownership across functions, reinforce accountability for commitments, and promote collaboration and continuous improvement across the two sites.
* Travel requirements will be a minimum of 25%, including regular presence across the two Texas sites.

**WHAT WE SEEK**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related field required.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including leadership responsibility for quality teams and manufacturing quality outcomes.
* 5+ years of quality management experience, with demonstrated ability to lead through site leaders or cross-functional teams; multi-site leadership experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success implementing quality systems and delivering sustained improvements in manufacturing quality, process capability, and cost of poor quality.
* Ability to coordinate priorities, standardize practices, and maintain effective leadership presence across two manufacturing sites in Texas.
* Experience supporting customer and supplier quality requirements, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable regulatory and industry requirements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence site leaders, resolve competing priorities, and communicate risks and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Demonstrated experience coaching quality leaders, developing technical capability, and building team depth and succession readiness across sites.
* Demonstrated ability to lead practical change, establish clear ownership, and sustain common quality practices in partnership with Operations and Engineering.
* Strong problem-solving, data analysis, and business acumen, with practical application of quality tools to prioritize risk, improve manufacturing processes, and deliver measurable results.

**WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS?**  
Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future.  
  
Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office.

**WHAT WE OFFER**  
Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals.

* Compensation: The salary range for this position is $134,000- $196,500 per year. Final compensation will depend on the candidate's overall skills and qualifications for the role.
* Annual bonus eligibility
* Progressive paid time off policy that empowers you to take the time you need to recharge
* Generous 401(K) plan with an impressive employer match with no delayed vesting
* Excellent health, dental and vision insurance packages to fit your needs
* Education assistance to support your learning journey
* A values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence

*Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future.*

*At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.*

Headquartered in Vineland, NJ, F&S Fresh Foods is leading the way in fresh-cut fruit, vegetables, and meal solutions distribution. With the recent acquisition of five additional state-of-the-art facilities strategically located across the U.S., we now deliver to customers across the United States and Canada — every single day!

For over 40 years, we’ve been redefining production and safety processes, building strong partnerships, and creating endless possibilities for our diverse customers — from restaurants and supermarket prepared food operations to convenience store chains and beyond. At F&S, we are fueling families with nutrition, innovation, and convenience, turning meals into memorable moments. By combining cutting-edge technology, deep-rooted customer relationships, and operational excellence, we are shaping the future of fresh — from farm to family.

We’re not just about food; we’re about people. Recognized as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, our team of 2,100 full-time employees drives our culture forward by living our values every day. If you’re ready to be part of a company that values innovation, excellence, and community impact, join us as we embrace our next exciting chapter of growth. Together, we’re planting the seeds of progress and nourishing a fresh, healthy future for everyone!

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* 401(K) including company match!
* Paid Time Off annually + Paid Holidays
* Career Advancement opportunities and Tuition Assistance

**What’s the Role**

The Vice President, Quality & Food Safety is F&S Fresh Foods’ senior executive leader for Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality across all of our facilities. This role sets the enterprise-wide strategy, standards, and systems that keep our products safe, consistent, and compliant with every regulatory, customer, and certification requirement. As the company’s senior authority on food safety risk, audit readiness, and crisis management, you will protect consumers, customers, and the F&S brand while partnering closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Product Development, Sales, and Executive Leadership. The ideal candidate is a strategic, data-driven leader who earns the trust of customers and regulators, develops strong teams, and champions a culture where food safety and quality are everyone’s responsibility.

**What You’ll Own**

* Set and execute the long-term Quality and Food Safety strategy, including enterprise goals, standards, KPIs, and governance processes aligned with business objectives
* Lead all corporate Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Compliance, Supplier Quality, and Customer Quality functions, ensuring consistent programs across all facilities
* Own the enterprise Food Safety Management System, including HACCP, Preventive Controls, Environmental Monitoring, Allergen Management, Traceability, Food Defense, and pathogen control
* Establish and maintain enterprise quality management systems so products consistently meet specifications, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements
* Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, FSMA, GFSI, state, local, and customer requirements, interpreting emerging regulations and maintaining audit and inspection readiness at every site
* Serve as senior liaison with regulatory agencies, certification bodies, and customer auditors, overseeing closure of audit findings, regulatory actions, and corrective actions
* Serve as executive authority and decision-maker for food safety incidents, recalls, and crisis response, maintaining risk assessment, traceability, mock recall, and incident management programs
* Represent F&S during customer visits, audits, business reviews, and quality events, building strategic relationships and leading resolution of significant complaints and brand-risk events
* Partner with Commercial, Product Development, and Operations to support growth while maintaining product integrity and improving customer satisfaction
* Establish supplier approval, audit, and monitoring standards and drive supplier performance improvement, partnering with Procurement to mitigate supply chain risk
* Drive data-based improvement to reduce defects, waste, and customer complaints and improve process capability, publishing executive dashboards and performance updates for leadership
* Lead and develop Directors, Managers, and technical leaders, building succession plans, bench strength, and a culture of accountability, engagement, and high performance
* Establish enterprise training standards and competency requirements, partnering with Operations and Human Resources to build food safety and quality into talent development and performance management
* Champion a companywide culture where food safety and quality are everyone’s responsibility, promoting proactive risk identification and continuous improvement
* Serve as the company’s senior subject matter expert on food safety, quality systems, microbiology, compliance, and regulatory matters
* Participate in strategic planning, acquisition integration activities, and enterprise transformation initiatives

Requirements:

* Must have: Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Food Technology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline; Master’s degree preferred
* Must have: HACCP and Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) certifications
* Must have: 15+ years of progressive Quality and Food Safety leadership, including 7+ years leading multi-site organizations
* Must have: Extensive experience in fresh, refrigerated, ready-to-eat, produce, protein, or other highly regulated food manufacturing
* Must have: Proven success leading customer audits, regulatory inspections, certification audits, recalls, and crisis events
* Must have: Strong knowledge of FDA, USDA, FSMA, GFSI, Environmental Monitoring Programs, and Quality Systems
* Nice to have: Lead Auditor, SQF Practitioner, BRCGS, or equivalent certification
* Personal quality: Strategic, consumer- and customer-focused decision-maker who uses metrics, risk assessments, and audit results to set priorities while balancing operational and commercial objectives

Founded in 1967, ImageFIRST® is the largest and only national linen rental and laundry service specializing in the healthcare market. Acquired by private equity firm Calera Capital in 2018, ImageFIRST serves medical facilities nationwide providing linen, patient gowns, scrubs, and more while managing their clients’ linen inventory for cost management. As leaders in infection prevention, they currently own and operate the most HLAC-accredited facilities in the industry. With one of the highest customer retention rates in the industry – 97% – ImageFIRST is dedicated to improving patient satisfaction and making staff happy with our white glove service!

Check out our company page: https://www.imagefirst.com/company/

**Director, Operational Excellence - CAPEX**
============================================

**Location:** East Coast (Northeast Preferred)  
**Travel:** Approximately 50%

**Position Summary**
--------------------

ImageFIRST is seeking a strategic, hands-on **Director, Operational Excellence** to lead enterprise-wide engineering initiatives, capital project planning, and operational improvement efforts across our national network of healthcare laundry facilities.

This newly created leadership role will serve as a key partner to Operations and the Senior Leadership Team, driving long-term asset strategy, **capital investment planning**, engineering support, and operational sustainability. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing strategic initiatives, leading complex projects, and rolling up their sleeves to solve operational challenges in the field.

This role offers a unique opportunity to build foundational processes that will standardize engineering practices and strengthen operational performance across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Capital Planning & Strategic Investments**

* Identify, prioritize, and develop capital expenditure (Capex) opportunities across the network.
* Build financial justifications, ROI analyses, and business cases for capital investments.
* Present capital recommendations and project proposals to the Senior Leadership Team.
* Partner with Finance and Operations to align capital investments with business strategy and growth objectives.

### **Project Engineering Leadership**

* Lead enterprise engineering projects from concept through implementation.
* Provide technical leadership for facility upgrades, equipment installations, automation initiatives, and operational improvements.
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and with measurable business impact.

### **Engineering Support for Plant Operations**

* Serve as a technical resource for manufacturing and plant leadership across the ImageFIRST network.
* Provide engineering guidance and problem-solving support for facilities requiring operational or technical assistance.
* Partner with General Managers and Operations Leaders to resolve complex equipment and process challenges.

### **Operational Excellence & Strategic Initiatives**

* Lead cross-functional operational improvement initiatives that support network stabilization, sustainability, and long-term operational performance.
* Partner with Operations Leadership to identify opportunities for increased efficiency, standardization, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted resource for high-impact operational projects across the business.

### **Safety Leadership**

* Champion a culture of safety across engineering and operational initiatives.
* Ensure engineering projects and equipment installations meet all applicable safety standards and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Environmental Health & Safety leadership to proactively reduce operational risk.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering, or capital project management.
* Experience leading multi-site engineering or operational initiatives.
* Proven experience managing capital projects and developing ROI-driven business cases.
* Strong knowledge of asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and reliability.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Strong financial acumen with experience presenting recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ability to travel approximately 50%.

### **Preferred**

* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing or industrial facilities.
* Plant management or operations leadership experience.
* Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement experience.
* Military leadership experience is highly valued, particularly candidates who have transitioned into manufacturing, engineering, or operations leadership roles.
* Experience within healthcare services, industrial laundry, textiles, food manufacturing, consumer products, or other asset-intensive industries.

**Leadership Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strategic thinker with strong operational execution
* Results-oriented and highly accountable
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills
* Strong analytical and financial decision-making capabilities
* Collaborative leadership style with the ability to influence across functions
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading enterprise-wide change
* Hands-on problem solver with a continuous improvement mindset

**Required Competencies:**

* Be Respectful: Value all we come in contact with
* Be Remarkable: Create a positive moment with every interaction
* Be Safe: Keep ourselves and those around us safe
* Be Honest: Be guided by truthfulness in all we do

**Benefits:**

* Weekly pay
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Pet, Legal, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance
* 401k (match)
* Paid Time Off Package
* Paid Parental Leave
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Referral Program
* Great company culture
* Collaborative team environment

EOE / Drug-Free Workplace

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are fueled by the talent, passion, and diversity of our associates.

existing_roles.description:
EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions helping industrial, infrastructure and defense customers address critical power and operational needs. The company delivers integrated solutions that combine energy storage technologies, power electronics, software-enabled intelligence, technical expertise and comprehensive global customer support. EnerSys supports customers across communications networks, data centers, energy infrastructure, material handling, transportation, aerospace and defense — including applications where power continuity is essential. Serving customers in more than 100 countries, EnerSys helps organizations manage energy more reliably, efficiently and intelligently in complex operating environments where uptime, safety and resilience matter.

  

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Plant Manager will provide overall leadership for the phased development, start-up, ramp-up, and ongoing operation of the new lithium-ion cell manufacturing facility in Greenville, South Carolina. This is a unique opportunity to build a factory and its organization from the ground up in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment.

The role will evolve through multiple phases of the project, beginning with facility construction and operational readiness and progressing through equipment installation and commissioning, production launch, workforce ramp-up, stabilization, and full-scale manufacturing operations.

The Plant Manager will be accountable for establishing the operating model, leadership capability, organizational structure, culture, management systems, and performance disciplines required to achieve excellence across safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, people, and customer satisfaction.

This leader must bring broad manufacturing expertise in a high-volume, fully automated environment and understand the interdependencies across production, engineering, maintenance, quality, supply chain, materials, EHS, finance, and people. The successful candidate will combine strong operational and financial acumen with knowledge of lithium-ion cell manufacturing and a demonstrated ability to build organizations, develop leaders, anticipate workforce needs, and establish strong relationships with employees, customers, suppliers, and business partners.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**Factory Development, Start-Up & Operational Readiness**

* Provide operational leadership throughout the phased development of the Greenville facility, ensuring manufacturing and operational requirements are incorporated as the factory is constructed, commissioned, launched, and scaled.
* Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, EHS, People & Culture, IT/OT, and other functions to establish comprehensive manufacturing readiness.
* Translate facility and project milestones into executable operational plans covering equipment, processes, workforce, training, materials, systems, safety, quality, and infrastructure.
* Ensure equipment, manufacturing processes, systems, organizational capability, and workforce readiness progress together so that potential gaps are identified and resolved before they impact production.
* Establish the operating systems, standard work, governance, performance metrics, escalation processes, and accountability required to transition successfully from project execution into manufacturing operations.
* Lead the operational transition through equipment installation and commissioning, qualification, production launch, ramp-up, stabilization, and full-scale operations.

**Manufacturing & Operational Leadership**

* Provide end-to-end leadership of plant operations with accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, capacity, employee performance, and overall manufacturing results.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of plant operating processes and ensure effective integration across production, maintenance, engineering, quality, supply chain, materials, EHS, and supporting functions.
* Establish a culture of operational excellence, disciplined execution, accountability, continuous improvement, and structured problem solving.
* Establish and continuously evaluate plant KPIs to identify performance gaps, determine root causes, and drive sustainable corrective actions.
* Drive improvement in manufacturing productivity, equipment effectiveness, reliability, throughput, yield, quality, labor efficiency, and operating cost.
* Ensure appropriate manufacturing systems, controls, procedures, and escalation mechanisms are established as production volume and organizational complexity increase.
* Champion Lean manufacturing principles and create a culture in which continuous improvement is embedded throughout the organization.

**Lithium-Ion Cell Manufacturing**

* Provide leadership within a technically complex lithium-ion cell manufacturing environment.
* Apply practical knowledge of cell manufacturing processes, automated manufacturing equipment, process controls, materials, quality requirements, and production risks to operational decision-making.
* Work closely with Cell Engineering, Process Engineering, Quality, EHS, and other technical teams to establish safe, repeatable, high-quality manufacturing processes capable of operating at scale.
* Ensure plant teams understand the relationships among process capability, product quality, yield, throughput, equipment performance, manufacturing cost, and customer requirements.
* Support the effective introduction, industrialization, and scale-up of new manufacturing processes and technologies.

**Financial & Business Leadership**
-----------------------------------

* Own plant operating performance from both an operational and financial perspective.
* Develop and manage plant operating budgets, forecasts, labor plans, productivity targets, capital requirements, and cost-improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of the economic drivers of manufacturing and translate operational performance into financial and business outcomes.
* Partner closely with Finance to understand and manage manufacturing cost, labor, productivity, inventory, scrap, yield, capital utilization, and other key plant performance drivers.
* Evaluate significant operational decisions through both manufacturing and financial lenses, balancing immediate execution requirements with the long-term capability and competitiveness of the plant.
* Establish strong cost-management and financial disciplines as the facility transitions from construction and start-up investment to sustainable manufacturing operations.

**Workforce Planning & Organizational Capability**

* Build the plant organization in phases aligned with facility construction, commissioning, production launch, ramp-up, and future operating requirements.
* Develop short- and long-term workforce plans to ensure the plant has the appropriate leadership, technical, skilled-trades, professional, and manufacturing capabilities required at each stage of growth.
* Anticipate talent, capacity, skill, and leadership gaps before they become constraints to manufacturing performance or future growth.
* Partner closely with People & Culture to develop recruiting, workforce planning, onboarding, training, retention, employee engagement, talent management, and organizational capability strategies.
* Establish clear organizational structures, decision rights, accountabilities, and leadership responsibilities as the facility grows and becomes operational.
* Develop workforce flexibility and organizational depth to mitigate single points of dependency and ensure business continuity.
* Regularly assess whether workforce capacity and capability are appropriately aligned with production requirements, operating plans, and future growth.

**Leadership Development & Succession**

* Recruit, build, coach, and develop a high-performing plant leadership team capable of successfully operating at increasing levels of scale and complexity.
* Establish a leadership culture where leaders are expected not only to deliver results but also to develop other leaders and build capability within their organizations.
* Partner with People & Culture to regularly assess leadership capability, organizational effectiveness, succession coverage, bench strength, and future talent requirements.
* Build strong succession pipelines for critical plant leadership and technical positions and ensure appropriate development plans are established for potential successors.
* Identify and develop high-potential talent through coaching, mentoring, expanded responsibilities, cross-functional experience, and targeted development opportunities.
* Establish sufficient leadership and technical depth to minimize organizational vulnerability and ensure continuity as the facility grows.
* Create a culture where talent development and succession planning are ongoing leadership responsibilities rather than periodic HR activities.

**Customer, Supplier & Stakeholder Leadership**
-----------------------------------------------

* Build strong, credible, long-term relationships with customers and ensure plant execution consistently supports quality, delivery, responsiveness, and customer commitments.
* Build strategic relationships with suppliers, equipment manufacturers, contractors, and other external partners critical to the construction, start-up, and ongoing operation of the plant.
* Work collaboratively with customers and suppliers to resolve issues quickly while protecting long-term business relationships.
* Serve as a senior representative of the Greenville operation with business leadership, customers, suppliers, community stakeholders, and other external partners as appropriate.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships across the broader organization and effectively navigate a complex, matrixed environment.
* Maintain a visible leadership presence throughout the plant and foster an employee environment built on communication, engagement, trust, accountability, and strong employee relations.

**Safety, Quality & Culture**

* Establish safety as a foundational operating principle and ensure appropriate systems, behaviors, and leadership accountability are embedded throughout the facility.
* Champion a quality-first mindset and ensure the organization consistently meets internal requirements and customer expectations.
* Build a high-performance culture characterized by accountability, collaboration, transparency, urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear expectations for leadership behavior and ensure those expectations cascade throughout the plant organization.
* Create an environment where employees understand how their work contributes to plant performance, customer success, and the broader business.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or a related discipline.
* Significant progressive leadership experience within complex, high-volume, highly automated, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading a significant manufacturing operation with accountability across safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, people, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated experience supporting or leading the build and start-up of a new manufacturing facility, significant plant expansion, major manufacturing transformation, or complex production ramp-up.
* Strong knowledge of lithium-ion cell manufacturing or relevant advanced manufacturing technologies and processes.
* Broad understanding of manufacturing operations and the interdependencies among production, engineering, maintenance, quality, supply chain, materials, EHS, finance, and people.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen with experience managing operating budgets, forecasts, manufacturing costs, capital investments, productivity, and business performance.
* Demonstrated success building, leading, coaching, and developing high-performing leadership teams.
* Experience with workforce planning, organizational design, talent development, and leadership succession.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with customers, suppliers, employees, executive leadership, and cross-functional partners.
* Proven ability to lead through ambiguity and rapidly changing priorities within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Direct experience in lithium-ion cell manufacturing or large-scale battery manufacturing.
* Experience taking a newly constructed manufacturing facility through commissioning, production launch, volume ramp-up, and stabilized operations.
* Experience with highly automated manufacturing equipment and advanced manufacturing technologies.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean manufacturing, structured problem solving, operational excellence, and continuous-improvement methodologies.
* Experience working within a global manufacturing organization or complex matrixed business environment.

**General Job Requirements**
----------------------------

* This position requires working in a plant/warehouse environment. Therefore, expect varying working conditions.

protected_roles.title: Corporate Food Safety Quality Assurance Director
protected_roles.description:
**We are willing to relocate to Rhode Island area for the right candidate**

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Corporate Food Safety Quality Assurance Director to lead our food safety and quality assurance programs. The Director will be responsible for ensuring the highest standards of food safety and quality across all operations, developing and implementing policies, and managing compliance with regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in food safety and quality assurance, with excellent leadership and analytical skills.

### **Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement comprehensive food safety programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

* Oversee quality assurance processes, including product testing, inspections, and audits to maintain high-quality standards.

* Create and enforce food safety and quality policies and procedures across all operations.

* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal food safety regulations, including FDA, USDA, and HACCP standards.

* Identify and manage food safety risks, implementing corrective actions and preventive measures.

* Develop and deliver training programs to educate employees on food safety and quality assurance practices.

* Monitor and analyze food safety and quality metrics to identify areas for improvement and implement the best practices.

* Lead and mentor the food safety and quality assurance team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance work environment.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, and regulatory agencies.

### **Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex food safety information.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in food safety and quality assurance processes.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

We’re looking for a Director, Quality to lead quality strategy and execution across Oura’s global engineering organization and supply chain.

### **What You Will Do:**

* In this role, you will ensure that quality and reliability are designed into our products, components, suppliers, and manufacturing processes from concept through development, launch, ramp, and sustaining operations. You will lead a global team of quality professionals and partner closely with Product Development, Hardware, Software, Reliability, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Customer Experience, and external suppliers.

Your team will help Oura identify risks early, make evidence-based decisions, prevent defects, and resolve complex issues with durable corrective actions.
